HC-MTS identifies six avoidable counterexamples, while no legal collision-producing attacker is found in the remaining two scenes within the finite search budget.

</details>


### [349] [WorldContact: A Contact-Centric World Model for Scalable Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19600)
*Caoliwen Wang,Mengdi Wang,Heng Zhang,Shixun Huang,Siyuan Chen,Chao Liu,Anpei Chen,Zhendong Wang,Peter Yichen Chen,Huamin Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WorldContact：面向可变形物体操作的接触中心世界模型，用少量高质量轨迹生成大量训练数据，实现10倍仿真加速，将真实机器人举袋任务单次成功率从65%提升至95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人适应新物体和新任务需要交互经验，而真实交互数据获取成本高昂；源数值仿真器为解析快速运动并防止穿透必须使用极小积分步长，导致仿真效率低、数据生成慢。

Method: 提出以接触为中心的世界模型WorldContact，基于有限的高质量轨迹构建；预测物体动力学时采用比源数值仿真器更大的时间步长，从而高效生成额外训练数据；在16项购物袋操作任务上评估，并用生成数据微调现有视觉-语言-动作策略，直接部署到真实机器人。

Result: 单张H100 GPU上的状态推演（不含渲染与磁盘I/O）相比源仿真器实现10倍加速；举袋任务中，仅用源仿真数据微调的策略单次成功率65%，而用WorldContact扩展数据集微调后达95%。

Conclusion: WorldContact支持高效数据生成，可有效用于机器人策略适应，显著提升真实部署成功率。

Abstract: Adapting robots to new objects and tasks requires interaction experience that can be costly to obtain. We present WorldContact, a contact-centric world model for deformable-object manipulation, constructed from a limited set of high-quality trajectories to generate additional training data efficiently. It predicts object dynamics using larger time steps than the source numerical simulator, which requires small integration steps to resolve rapid motion and prevent interpenetration. We evaluate WorldContact across 16 shopping-bag manipulation tasks. State-rollout measurements on a single H100 GPU show a $10\times$ speedup over the source simulator, excluding rendering and disk I/O. We use the generated data to fine-tune an existing vision-language-action policy and deploy it directly on a real robot. In bag lifting, the same policy achieves 65% single-attempt success when fine-tuned on source simulation data alone, compared with 95% when fine-tuned on the dataset expanded with WorldContact. These results support efficient data generation with WorldContact for robot policy adaptation.

</details>


### [350] [TacSushi: Tactile-Grounded World-Action Modeling for Dexterous Sushi Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19613)
*Haodi Hu,Kaen Kogashi,Toshiaki Koike-Akino*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TacSushi是一种基于Cosmos3、以触觉为基础的世界-动作策略，在训练时借助未来结果预测监督，部署时移除预测解码器；在真实机器人食物操作任务中，其在分布内/外成功率显著优于消融版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧食物操作面临形变、遮挡和接触不确定性，需要有效利用触觉信息并对操作后果进行建模；同时失败试验蕴含丰富的结果监督信号，但不宜直接用于模仿学习。

Method: 主干网络编码当前RGB、语言和手部状态；采用特征级门控融合将指尖触觉特征注入动作表示。训练阶段，以示范动作块为条件的解码器预测已记录的未来视觉观测、任务进度、相对接触风险和触觉摘要，部署时移除该解码器。失败试验仅用于后果监督，其动作不纳入模仿。模型基于340次成功和50次失败的真实机器人试验训练，在3个分布内任务与2个分布外食材变体上进行600次独立rollout，比较6种方法；终端结果用锚定视觉质量协议评分，等权融合5个人工评分与3个视觉语言模型评分。

Result: 完整TacSushi在分布内平均成功率为68.3%，分布外为37.5%；去掉未来后果监督后为36.7%/10.0%；用直接触觉拼接替代门控融合后为25.0%/17.5%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，特征级门控触觉融合与仅训练期使用的预测性监督具有互补收益，均对灵巧食物操作策略性能有重要贡献。

Abstract: Dexterous food manipulation requires control under deformation, occlusion, and uncertain contact. We present TacSushi, a tactile-grounded, Cosmos3-based world-action policy that learns from recorded future consequences while acting on current observations. The backbone encodes current RGB, language, and hand state, and feature-wise gated fusion incorporates fingertip tactile features into the action representation. During training, a decoder conditioned on demonstrated action chunks predicts logged future visual observations, task progress, relative contact risk, and tactile summaries; this decoder is removed at deployment. Failed trials provide consequence supervision, but their actions are excluded from imitation. We train TacSushi on 340 successful and 50 failed real-robot trials and compare six methods in 600 separate rollouts across three in-distribution tasks and two out-of-distribution ingredient variants. To assess food quality beyond a single geometric threshold, we score terminal outcomes using an anchored visual-quality protocol that equally weights five human ratings and three vision-language-model ratings per rollout. Full TacSushi achieves 68.3% average in-distribution success and 37.5% out-of-distribution success, compared with 36.7%/10.0% without future-consequence supervision and 25.0%/17.5% with direct tactile concatenation in place of gated fusion. These comparisons support complementary benefits of feature-wise gated tactile fusion and training-only predictive supervision.

</details>


### [351] [EmbodiedMind: Adaptive Data Curation and Prefix-Tree Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19659)
*Feifan Wang,Zongbing Zhang,Yu Zhang,Lingfeng Wang,Yurui Zhu,Jin Deng,Mingliang Zhang,Zhengguang Gao,Yongcheng Wang,Jin Xu,Ri Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出高效训练范式EmbodiedMind，结合数据筛选与分层策略优化，在18个基准上达到70.02%的SOTA平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身基础模型训练面临三大瓶颈：低信息样本导致样本利用率低、异构任务间梯度贡献不平衡、长时程规划中轨迹级奖励对所有token进行无差别惩罚造成严重的信用分配问题。

Method: 提出三阶段协同训练范式：（1）RSFT，基于拒绝采样微调过滤低信息样本，建立鲁棒行为先验并防止分布坍塌；（2）IR-GRPO，采用按难度分层的任务专属队列，在强化学习迭代中保持数据均衡，并结合混合奖励机制实现精确的跨任务反馈；（3）Trie-GRPO，基于动作前缀树的新型强化学习算法，实现步级优势估计，通过隔离中间正确决策与下游错误解决信用分配问题，并平衡探索效率与深度。

Result: EmbodiedMind在18个基准上取得70.02%的SOTA平均性能，在长时程任务规划准确率上显著优于其他具身基础模型。

Conclusion: 该训练范式通过策略性数据选择与分层策略优化，在无需大规模数据与算力的前提下实现高效训练与领先性能，项目将开源以保证可复现性。

Abstract: Training embodied foundation models typically requires massive-scale datasets and extensive computational resources, yet often suffers from three critical limitations: (1) inefficient sample utilization due to low-informative samples; (2) imbalanced gradient contributions across heterogeneous tasks; and (3) severe credit assignment problem in long-horizon planning, where trajectory-level rewards indiscriminately penalize all tokens. To address these issues, we propose an efficient training paradigm that achieves state-of-the-art average performance through strategic data selection and hierarchical policy optimization. Our approach consists of three synergistic stages. First, Rejection Sampling-based Fine-Tuning (RSFT) filters out low-informative samples to establish robust behavioral priors while preventing distributional collapse. Second, Iterative Rejection GRPO (IR-GRPO) employs task-specific queues stratified by difficulty to keep datasets balanced across reinforcement learning iterations, coupled with a hybrid reward mechanism for precise cross-task feedback. Third, to enhance long-horizon task planning, we introduce Trie-GRPO, a novel reinforcement learning algorithm based on action prefix trees, which enables step-level advantage estimation. This resolves the credit assignment problem by isolating intermediate correct decisions from downstream errors, while effectively balancing exploration efficiency and depth compared to conventional search trees. As a result, EmbodiedMind achieves a state-of-the-art average performance of 70.02% across 18 benchmarks, and significantly outperforms other embodied foundation models in long-horizon task planning accuracy. Our project will be released for reproducibility.

</details>


### [352] [ReShoot: Generative Visual Domain Randomization of Recorded Robot Demonstrations for Visuomotor Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19661)
*Chiyoung Kim,Min Sung Choi,Jinho Ju,Chanhoe Gu,Donghwan Hwang,Wonseok Choi,Woongsun Jeon,Minhyeok Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ReShoot通过重渲染已有示教来合成视觉多样性，避免在新外观条件下重复采集数据，并在仿真与真实机器人上验证了其提升外观鲁棒性的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习策略常过拟合训练示范中的视觉条件，物体颜色或背景变化会导致性能显著下降。常规缓解方法是在每个新视觉场景中额外采集示范，但这需要反复使用机器人、受控环境和人工操作，资源开销大。

Method: ReShoot将数据采集负担转为数据生成：用视觉语言模型对场景进行描述并编辑目标属性（如背景、物体颜色或材质），再由边缘条件视频生成器重渲染两个相机视角，并同步更新指令；动作序列和本体感知轨迹直接复制、不重新标注，使生成片段保留原动作与本体感知标签。

Result: 在LIBERO上，使用录制与重渲染示范等量混合训练的策略性能与仅用录制数据训练相当（96.5% vs. 96.9%）；混合训练集在LIBERO-Plus上对场景扰动的鲁棒性更强（85.5% vs. 82.3%）。在两个真实机器人平台上，使用43条和100条预采集示范时，ReShoot将重着色物体上的成功率分别从0.0%提升至42.9%和47.5%，同时保持原始录制外观下的性能。

Conclusion: 重渲染已有示范可有效合成视觉多样性，在几乎不损失原始性能的前提下提升策略对视觉扰动的鲁棒性，并显著改善真实机器人在新物体外观下的成功率，是一种比重复采集数据更高效的替代方案。

Abstract: Imitation-learned robot policies are frequently overfit to the visual conditions present in their training demonstrations. Consequently, variations in object color or background appearance often induce substantial performance degradation. A common mitigation strategy is to acquire additional demonstrations in each novel visual context; however, this approach is resource-intensive, requiring repeated access to a robot, a controlled environment, and human operation for every appearance condition to be covered. We introduce ReShoot, a framework that synthesizes visual diversity by re-rendering previously recorded demonstrations under altered appearances, thereby shifting the burden from data collection to generation. A vision-language model captions the scene, edits a targeted attribute (e.g., background, object color, or material), and an edge-conditioned video generator re-renders both camera views to match. The instruction is updated accordingly. The action sequence and proprioceptive trajectory are copied verbatim without relabeling, so each generated episode retains the recorded action and proprioceptive labels. On LIBERO, a policy trained on an equal mixture of recorded and re-rendered demonstrations matches the performance of recorded-only training (96.5% vs. 96.9%). Moreover, the mixed training set improves robustness to scene perturbations on LIBERO-Plus (85.5% vs. 82.3%). Across two physical robotic platforms, deploying ReShoot with 43 and 100 pre-collected demonstrations increased the success rate on recolored objects from 0.0% to 42.9% and 47.5%, respectively, while maintaining performance under the original recorded appearance.

</details>


### [353] [Runtime Safety Filtering for Two-Terminal Hazards in Robotic Battery Recycling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19665)
*Yuxin Cao,Wei Song,Xianglin Yang,Fusen Guo,Lin Li,Xiao Cheng,Jin Song Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究针对双端接触型危害（如电池回收中导电载荷同时接近两个端子才短路），在LIBERO环境下基于冻结的OpenVLA策略研究运行时安全过滤器。将过滤器分解为谓词结构、几何裕度与回退动作三项设计选择，发现谓词结构（合取、双点禁区、复合）在各自最优裕度下给出几乎相同的安全—效用前沿，而回退策略影响显著更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统运行时安全过滤器将不安全状态定义为逐物体的禁区并集，对依赖关节空间关系的危害（如载荷需同时接近两个端子才触发短路）过于保守或表征不当。作者希望厘清在接近型操作危害中，过滤器的谓词结构、几何裕度与回退策略三者究竟哪一项对安全—效用权衡起主导作用。

Method: 在LIBERO环境中使用冻结的OpenVLA策略。过滤器设计分解为三部分：(1) 谓词结构——合取谓词、传统双点禁区、二者复合；(2) 几何裕度——对每个谓词调节裕度以刻画任务成功与残余危害之间的前沿；(3) 回退策略——在匹配工作点上比较保持、撤退、采样搜索、连续动作屏障投影四种方式。跨三个工作单元、第二个策略与任务套件进行迁移验证，并测试清晰度估计误差（独立误差与载荷尺寸相关误差）下的鲁棒性。

Result: 三类谓词族在各自裕度上评估后描绘出几乎相同的安全—效用前沿。回退策略影响显著更大：相比撤退，保持最多降低0.302的任务成功率却不减少危害，而两种最小侵入式回退（采样搜索、屏障投影）留下明显更多残余危害。该排序可迁移到第二个策略与任务套件。基于撤退的过滤器在清晰度存在稳态误差时仍有效，但载荷尺寸估计中的相关误差比端子位置的较大独立误差更具破坏性。

Conclusion: 对于接近定义的操作危害，裕度选择与回退策略在决定运行时过滤器的安全—效用权衡上比谓词结构更重要。这提示实践者应优先关注回退设计与裕度标定，而非过度设计谓词形式。

Abstract: Runtime safety filters for learned manipulation policies typically define unsafe states as unions of object-wise keep-out regions. This representation can be unnecessarily restrictive for hazards that depend on a joint spatial relation, such as battery recycling, where a conductive payload can short a charged cell only when it approaches both terminals simultaneously. We study runtime filtering for this two-terminal hazard in LIBERO using frozen OpenVLA policies. We factor a runtime filter into three design choices: the predicate structure, its geometric margin, and the fallback action applied when a commanded action is rejected. We compare a conjunctive predicate, a conventional two-site keep-out, and a composite of the two. For each predicate, we vary its margin to obtain a frontier between task success and residual hazard. We then compare four fallback strategies at matched operating points: holding, retreat, sampled search, and a continuous-action barrier projection. Across three workcells, the three predicate families trace nearly identical safety--utility frontiers once each is evaluated over its own margin. In contrast, the fallback strategy has a substantially larger effect: holding reduces task success by up to 0.302 relative to retreat without reducing hazard, while both minimally invasive fallbacks leave substantially more residual hazard. This ordering transfers to a second policy and task suite, while retreat-based filtering remains effective under standing errors in the clearances available to the filter, although correlated error in the estimated payload size is more damaging than larger independent errors in terminal position. These results show that, for proximity-defined manipulation hazards, margin selection and fallback strategy can matter more than predicate structure in determining the safety--utility trade-off of a runtime filter.

</details>


### [354] [Towards High-DoF Dexterous Manipulation through VLA Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19666)
*Junlei Zhu,Shenzhe Yao,Chaogui Huang,Wenkai Zhu,Jingwei Peng,Guanqi He,Soren Schwertfeger,Jiahao Chen,Yide Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出四步后训练流水线（手部动作编解码器、SFT、DAgger、真实世界残差RL），将预训练VLA适配到高自由度灵巧手，在5个真实任务中20次试验全部成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习获得的VLA基础模型虽具备广泛操作能力，但在特定下游任务与硬件上仍需后训练。灵巧手因行为库广、自由度大而带来结构化大动作空间，适配尤为困难：开源VLA缺乏高自由度手部动作接口；人类接管的DAgger中手势不匹配导致指令不连续并污染纠正轨迹；原始关节空间的强化学习样本效率低。

Method: 统一的四步后训练流水线：(1) 学习式时间手部动作编解码器，使预训练VLA可输出绝对灵巧手指令；(2) 监督微调；(3) DAgger，通过缓冲回滚、姿态对齐与平滑指令混合实现连续且任务相关的纠正；(4) 真实世界残差强化学习，将探索限制在编解码器捕获的协调手部动作潜空间中。

Result: 在双臂迁移、手内重定向、工具使用等5个多样化真实任务上评估，在报告的后训练预算内，所得策略在每个任务20次试验中均达到100%成功率。

Conclusion: 该流水线为将VLA基础模型适配至可靠的真实世界灵巧操作提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Imitation-learned vision--language--action (VLA) foundation models acquire broad manipulation capabilities by scaling robot data across tasks and embodiments, but reliable deployment on a specific downstream task and hardware platform still requires post-training. Dexterous hands make this adaptation particularly difficult: their broad behavioural repertoire and high degree of freedom create a large and structured action space. Three obstacles are central: open-source VLAs do not natively provide an action interface for high-DoF hands; gesture mismatch during human-gated DAgger takeover creates command discontinuities and contaminates corrective trajectories; and reinforcement learning in the raw joint space is sample-inefficient. We present a unified four-step post-training pipeline comprising a learned temporal hand-action codec, supervised fine-tuning, DAgger, and real-world residual reinforcement learning. The codec adapts a pretrained VLA to absolute dexterous-hand commands. Buffered rollback, pose alignment, and smooth command blending enable continuous, task-relevant DAgger corrections, while latent residual RL confines exploration to coordinated hand motions captured by the codec. We evaluate the pipeline on five diverse real-world tasks spanning bimanual transfer, in-hand reorientation, and tool use. Within the reported post-training budgets, the resulting policies achieve 100\% success on every evaluated task over 20 trials per task. These results provide a practical path for adapting VLA foundation models to reliable real-world dexterous manipulation.

</details>


### [355] [VAST: V2X/Dynamic Map-Aware Autonomous Driving Systems Validation Toolchain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19681)
*Shunsuke Ito,Takuya Azumi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VAST：面向V2X/动态地图的协同自动驾驶验证工具链，实现Scenic、SS2、AWSIM、Autoware与SIM-LDM的互操作，提升边缘案例发现率与安全性评估效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协同自动驾驶涉及车、路侧传感、边缘动态地图服务与车载自动驾驶栈，需系统级验证；现有工具间缺乏互操作性，难以在IoT-Edge-Cloud连续体上完成端到端验证。

Method: 提出VAST工具链，不引入新搜索算法，重点解决互操作性：Lanelet2到Scenic映射、基于ROS 2的SS2协同仿真、向Autoware注入动态地图对象，并采集TTC、PET、碰撞、超时及性能指标；在遮挡交叉口场景下进行Lanelet2兼容的约束采样，并进行1-16个NPC的吞吐研究。

Result: 遮挡交叉口场景中，约束采样将边缘案例发现率从40.0%提升至80.0%，平均发现时间从259.7 s降至110.4 s；相同场景分布下，动态地图可用使碰撞率从78.0%降至40.0%，非碰撞结果从22.0%升至60.0%，TTC/PET变化具统计显著性；1-16 NPC下采样时间低于0.1 s，运行时间由AWSIM/Autoware执行与重启开销主导。

Conclusion: VAST可作为协同自动驾驶信息物理系统（CPS）的实用验证基础设施，通过互操作性集成提升边缘案例发现效率并支撑安全评估。

Abstract: Cooperative autonomous driving in the IoT-to-Edge-to-Cloud continuum requires system-level validation across vehicles, infrastructure sensors, edge-side Dynamic Map services, and in-vehicle autonomous-driving stacks. This paper presents VAST, a V2X/Dynamic Map-aware validation toolchain that connects Scenic, Scenario Simulator v2, AWSIM, Autoware, and SIM-LDM. VAST does not introduce a new search algorithm; instead, it addresses interoperability challenges, including Lanelet2-to-Scenic mapping, ROS 2-based co-simulation through SS2, Dynamic Map object injection into Autoware, and collection of TTC, PET, collision, timeout, and performance measurements. In occluded-intersection scenarios, Lanelet2-compatible constrained sampling increases the edge-case discovery rate from 40.0% to 80.0% and reduces the average time per discovered edge case from 259.7 s to 110.4 s. Under the same generated scenario distribution, Dynamic Map availability reduces the collision rate from 78.0% to 40.0% and increases non-collision outcomes from 22.0% to 60.0%, with statistically significant TTC/PET shifts. A throughput study with 1-16 NPCs shows that sampling remains below 0.1 s, whereas AWSIM/Autoware execution and restart overhead dominate runtime. These results position VAST as a practical validation infrastructure for cooperative autonomous-driving CPSs.

</details>


### [356] [LYRIC: Language-Driven Physics-Based Character Control for Contact-Rich Whole-Body Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19688)
*Zeyu Han,Zichong Meng,Julian Tanke,Minami Matsumoto,Sergey Bashkirov,Yingruo Fan,Selim Engin,Dongseok Shim,Takashi Shibuya,Yuki Mitsufuji,Huaizu Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LYRIC 是一种基于语言驱动的生成式流匹配控制器，用于物理仿真中富接触全身物体交互，结合任务级规划器与动作生成器，并通过策略后调优提升成功率与语义对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从自由形式语言指令和稀疏终端物体目标出发，实现物理仿真人形角色的富接触全身物体交互，同时避免依赖完整全身运动学参考，并解决运动捕捉参考不完美导致专家轨迹不可靠的问题。

Method: 采用几何条件交互奖励与手-物接触附近的松弛参考跟踪训练单一跟踪策略以获取可靠专家轨迹；将控制器分解为任务级规划器（预测短时域物体与人形根轨迹）和动作生成器（闭环求解全身运动与接触）；在行为克隆后冻结规划器，并以规划器预测作为稳定监督对动作生成器进行在线策略后调优。

Result: 在受控 OMOMO 评测中，跟踪器成功率 64.3%，高于 InterMimic 复现的 53.2%；统一策略在完整 OMOMO 数据集上达 76.5%；在留出划分上，LYRIC 任务成功率 90.3%，优于最强匹配运动学规划基线 74.2%，并具有更好的语义对齐与运动质量；无需重训练即可支持测试时物体路点引导，并可零样本迁移至新物体形状。

Conclusion: LYRIC 通过分解式规划-生成架构与规划器监督的策略后调优，实现了稳定、自然的语言驱动富接触全身物体交互，并在成功率、语义对齐、运动质量及零样本泛化方面优于现有基线。

Abstract: We present LYRIC, a generative flow-matching controller for language-driven physics-based contact-rich interaction control, that enables simulated characters to perform contact-rich whole-body object interactions from a free-form language instruction and a sparse terminal object goal. To obtain reliable expert trajectories from imperfect motion-capture references, a single tracking policy is trained using geometry-conditioned interaction rewards and relaxed reference tracking near hand-object contact. To guide interaction progress without prescribing a full-body kinematic reference, we factorize the controller into a task-level planner that predicts short-horizon object and humanoid-root trajectories, and an action generator that resolves whole-body motion and contacts in closed loop. After behavior cloning, we freeze the planner and post-tune the action generator on policy using the planner's predictions as stable supervision for intermediate task progression. In a controlled OMOMO evaluation, our tracker achieves 64.3% success compared with 53.2% for an InterMimic reimplementation, while a unified policy achieves 76.5% on the full OMOMO dataset. On the held-out split, LYRIC achieves 90.3% task success, compared with 74.2% for the strongest matched kinematic-planner baseline, with better semantic alignment and motion quality. Without retraining, the controller also supports test-time object-waypoint guidance. Qualitative results further demonstrate robust, natural contact-rich interactions and zero-shot transfer to novel object shapes. The webpage is available at https://neu-vi.github.io/LYRIC/

</details>


### [357] [UniExo: Unified Multi-Skill Policies for Musculoskeletal Locomotion and Co-Adaptive Exoskeleton Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19690)
*Yifei Yuan,Jakob Wolf,Ghaith Androwis,Xianlian Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 UniExo 框架，先构建多技能人体肌骨策略，再与其联合训练统一的髋关节外骨骼控制策略，实现步行、转弯、跑步和倒走四类运动及转换的连续辅助，无需技能标签或显式模式切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日常运动包含多种活动及频繁转换，但多数外骨骼控制器仅针对单一或少数相关动作设计，活动改变通常需要显式模式切换并重新调参或重训控制器；基于仿真的学习虽减少硬件调试，却仍保留这一局限。

Method: 首先将步行、转弯、跑步、倒走四个单技能模仿专家蒸馏为带技能隐变量的单一网络，并在转换序列上通过强化学习微调，得到统一人体策略；随后以该人体策略的髋关节力矩预测初始化一个髋关节外骨骼控制器（UniExo），通过多智能体强化学习在四项技能间与人体策略共同适应。

Result: 统一人体策略在四类技能的未见片段上平均跟踪成功率达 94.7%，扰动鲁棒性优于各组成专家；共同适应改变了辅助力矩的时序并提高了向髋关节输出正功的比例；在定制髋关节外骨骼上，控制器在六名参与者、四种跑步机速度下泛化，并辅助一名参与者连续完成四项技能及其转换，无需技能标签或显式模式切换。

Conclusion: UniExo 为以统一、用户特定的控制器替代活动特定控制器迈出一步，能够支持多样运动活动及其相互转换。

Abstract: Daily locomotion encompasses diverse activities and frequent transitions between them, yet most exoskeleton controllers are designed for a single activity or a narrow set of related movements. Changes in activity therefore typically require explicit mode switching and separately tuned or retrained controllers. Simulation-based learning reduces the need for hardware-based tuning but generally retains this limitation. Here we present UniExo, a framework that first constructs a multi-skill musculoskeletal human policy and then jointly trains an exoskeleton control policy with it. Four single-skill imitation experts for walking, turning, running and backward walking are distilled into a single network structured by a skill latent and subsequently fine-tuned through reinforcement learning on transition sequences. The resultant unified human policy achieves a mean tracking success rate of 94.7% on unseen clips of the four skills and exhibits greater robustness to perturbations than its constituent experts. A single hip exoskeleton controller (UniExo) is initialized from hip moment prediction of the human policy and co-adapted with it through multi-agent reinforcement learning across the four skills. This co-adaptation shifts the timing of the assistance torque and raises the fraction of positive work delivered to the hip. When deployed on a custom hip exoskeleton, the controller generalizes across four treadmill speeds in six participants and assists one participant through a continuous route of all four skills and their transitions, without skill labels or explicit mode switching. UniExo thus provides a step towards replacing activity-specific controllers with unified, user-specific controllers that support diverse locomotor activities and the transitions between them.

</details>


### [358] [Decoupling Physical Speed from Path Parameterization in Singularity-Free Guiding Vector Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19726)
*Zhouru Xiao,Sha Luo,Yang Lu,Mingliang Xiao,Weijia Yao,Bohuan Lin,Xianzhe Cheng,Yaonan Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种新的无奇异引导向量场（SF-GVF）实现预设物理速度（PPS），可在高维空间中指数收敛到期望路径，同时保证机器人物理速度收敛到预设值，并设计饱和加速度控制律，通过仿真与四旋翼实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有带虚拟坐标的SF-GVF虽能消除传统GVF的奇异点并保证全局收敛，但沿路径的速度依赖于路径参数化、无法任意指定；简单的部分归一化方法会因归一化分母为零而引入新奇异点。

Method: 提出一种具有预设物理速度（PPS）的新型SF-GVF，其积分曲线从高维空间（含虚拟维）任意初值出发指数收敛至期望路径，且路径误差动力学在期望路径的正则重参数化下保持不变；并针对二阶运动学模型设计饱和加速度控制律。

Result: 对比仿真与不同PPS曲线下的四旋翼3D路径跟随实验验证了理论结果，证明了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该PPS-SF-GVF在保持全局收敛与无奇异性的同时，实现了物理速度的任意指定，并适用于二阶动力学控制与实际机器人路径跟随。

Abstract: The existing singularity-free guiding vector field (SF-GVF) with an additional virtual coordinate can eliminate singular points (i.e., points where the vector field vanishes) inherent in conventional GVFs and guarantee global convergence of robot trajectories to closed and self-intersecting desired paths. However, the desired speed given by the GVF along the desired path in the original lower-dimensional space cannot be arbitrarily specified but depends on path parameterizations. One possible workaround is to partially normalize the physical projection of the SF-GVF and assign a user-designed speed. However, we show that this workaround may introduce new singularities since the normalization denominator can become zero. To address this issue, we propose a new SF-GVF with prescribed physical speed (PPS). The integral curves of the new SF-GVF converge exponentially to the desired path from any initial condition in the higher-dimensional space (including virtual dimension); more importantly, the robot's physical speed converges to the PPS, while the path-error dynamics remain invariant under regular reparameterizations of the desired path. We further develop a saturated acceleration control law for second-order kinematic models. Finally, comparative simulations and 3D path-following experiments with a quadrotor under different PPS profiles validate the theoretical results and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [359] [Equivariant Filter Design for Acoustic and Depth Aided Inertial Navigation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19742)
*Arihant Lunawat,Pieter van Goor,Frank Dellaert,Stefan B. Williams*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于切群(TG)对称性的等变滤波器(TG-EqF),将IMU零偏纳入状态空间几何中,实现AUV无GPS导航的高一致性状态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AUV无GPS导航通常融合惯性测量、DVL速度和压力深度。基于李群的导航状态可提升精度与一致性,但现有IEKF方法将IMU零偏以欧氏方式附加,破坏了群仿射结构,导致无法得到精确的对数线性误差动态,进而使协方差估计退化。因此需要一种保持群结构的新滤波框架。

Method: 采用切群(TG)对称性,使零偏被承载于状态空间的几何结构内,推导出该系统的等变滤波器(EqF):导航状态零线性化误差,零偏仅存在二阶误差;为DVL构建等变输出模型(其更新仅引入三阶线性化误差),并采用直接压力输出模型。

Result: 蒙特卡洛仿真将TG-EqF与双框架群IEKF及乘性EKF进行基准对比:TG-EqF在姿态、速度、位置三方面相对两者误差降低18–25%;其主要优势体现在协方差估计上,其ANEES更接近理想值1。基于AUV实测数据的离线分析亦验证了仿真结论,显示出更小的位置漂移。

Conclusion: TG-EqF通过将IMU零偏纳入群几何结构,克服了IEKF因欧氏扩展零偏而破坏群仿射结构、导致协方差退化的缺陷,在精度与一致性上均优于现有滤波方法,并在实际AUV现场数据中得到验证。

Abstract: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) navigating without GPS typically fuse inertial measurements with acoustic Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) velocities and pressure-derived depth. Posing the navigation state on a Lie group improves accuracy and consistency. However, state-of-the-art filters based on the Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (IEKF) append the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) biases as a Euclidean extension, which breaks the group-affine structure required for exact log-linear error dynamics, causing the reported covariance to degrade alongside the estimate. We apply the Tangent-Group (TG) symmetry, which carries the biases within the geometry of the state space, to derive an Equivariant Filter (EqF) for this system, leaving zero linearization error in the navigation states and second-order error only in the biases. We develop an equivariant output model for the DVL, whose update incurs only third-order linearization error, together with a direct pressure output. Monte Carlo simulations benchmark the TG-EqF against a Two-Frame-Group IEKF and a Multiplicative EKF. The TG-EqF reduces error by 18--25\% against both alternatives in each of attitude, velocity, and position. The main benefit is in the covariance it estimates: its Average Normalized Estimation Error Squared (ANEES) stays closer to its nominal value of one than that of the others. Offline analysis on AUV field data corroborates the findings of the simulations, demonstrating reduced position drift.

</details>


### [360] [LIFD: Anchored Diffusion for 3D-Aware Scene Memory in Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19796)
*Wenbo Li,Yiteng Chen,Wenhao Li,Qingyao Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LIFD 是一个面向部分可观测机器人操作的持久化 3D 感知场景记忆框架，通过场景 token 表示、整流流补全与锚点引导交叉注意力，结合紧凑 slot 特征驱动策略，在 LIBERO、MetaWorld 与真实 UR5e 任务上取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作在部分可观测条件下需要超越当前视野的空间信息。几何感知的 RGB 特征只能描述可见结构，而随着机器人或场景移动，先前观测到的区域可能消失。因此，维持有用的场景表示需要保留观测历史，并在不丢失与可见证据联系的前提下推断缺失内容。

Method: 提出 LIFD（Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do）框架，用于持久化、3D 感知的场景记忆。LIFD 从多视图一致性中学习场景 token 表示，并借助单张 RGB 视图与循环记忆完成补全。采用整流流（rectified-flow）模型生成 token，并通过 Anchor-Guided Cross-Attention 以当前几何特征为条件进行补全。紧凑 slot 特征将该表示连接至操作策略。表示学习阶段使用多视图与几何监督；部署时仅需一个 RGB 相机、本体感知和任务指令。

Result: LIFD（Staged）在 LIBERO 上达到 91.6% 平均成功率，在 MetaWorld 上达到 79.8%，相较 Joint 训练在 LIBERO 平均成功率上提升 3.1 个百分点。在四个 UR5e 任务族（每族十条演示）上，平均成功率为 56.0%，而 OpenVLA-7B 为 40.5%。

Conclusion: LIFD 通过持久化 3D 感知场景记忆与生成式补全机制，有效解决了部分可观测操作中的空间信息缺失问题，并在仿真与真实机器人任务上均优于基线方法，验证了其表示学习与部署范式的有效性。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation under partial observability requires spatial information that extends beyond the current view. Geometry-aware RGB features describe visible structure, but previously observed regions may disappear as the robot or scene moves. Maintaining a useful scene representation therefore requires retaining observation history while inferring missing content without losing its connection to visible evidence. We introduce LIFD (Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do), a framework for persistent, 3D-aware scene memory. LIFD learns a scene-token representation from multi-view agreement and completes it from a single RGB view and recurrent memory. A rectified-flow model generates the tokens while Anchor-Guided Cross-Attention conditions completion on current geometric features. Compact slot features connect this representation to a manipulation policy. Multi-view and geometric supervision are used during representation learning; deployment requires one RGB camera, proprioception, and a task instruction. LIFD (Staged) reaches 91.6% average success on LIBERO and 79.8% on MetaWorld, improving LIBERO average success by 3.1 percentage points over Joint training. On four UR5e task families with ten demonstrations per family, it achieves 56.0% mean success, compared with 40.5% for OpenVLA-7B.

</details>


### [361] [Affective Shared Autonomy: Temporal Affect Dynamics and Subjective Evaluation in Bimanual Teleoperation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19802)
*Zhengji Liang,Guiyin Tian,Sijin Qu,Hainan Liu,Shiyan Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出情感感知的共享自主遥操作框架，依据操作员实时情感状态动态调节机器人辅助，用户研究(N=30)表明"有益状态"占比最高提升39.7%且不损害用户自主性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理遥操作融合人类认知灵活性与机器人精度，但高难度操作任务易引发严重认知负荷、挫败感与执行失败。传统共享自主范式主要依赖基于任务的规则（如空间误差边界），忽视操作员瞬时的情感状态，可能导致控制干预失准。

Method: 从同步采集的面部视频、心电信号与双臂运动学中估计操作员情感状态，输出七类情感分布及三类操作抽象（中性、有益、不利）；当检测到持续不利状态时选择性触发情感感知辅助。数据集为首个在双手遥操作中提供视觉、生理与操作员双臂运动连续跟踪的多模态数据集。多模态融合模型用于追踪时序状态动态。

Result: 用户研究(N=30)证实所提情感辅助使"有益状态"最高提升39.7%，且未损害用户自主性；多模态融合模型在追踪时序状态动态方面优于零样本基线(Qwen、MiniCPM-V)。

Conclusion: 该真实部署为物理人机交互提供了融合视觉、生理与运动跟踪的以人为中心的新框架，弥补了传统基于任务规则范式的不足。

Abstract: Physical teleoperation integrates human cognitive flexibility with robotic precision, yet demanding manipulation tasks frequently induce severe cognitive workload, acute frustration, and execution breakdown. Conventional shared autonomy paradigms rely primarily on task-based rules, such as spatial error boundaries, which disregard the operator's transient affective state and risk misaligned control interventions. To address this limitation, we propose an affect-aware shared autonomy teleoperation framework that dynamically modulates robotic assistance based on real-time operator state estimation. The system estimates operator affective states from synchronized facial video, cardiac signals, and bilateral arm kinematics, outputting a seven-state affective distribution and a three-category operational abstraction (neutral, productive, adverse). Affect-aware assistance is selectively triggered when the user is detected in a continuous adverse state, preserving task-positive engagement without unnecessary disruption. The empirical user study ($N = 30$) confirms that the proposed affective assistance increases the productive states by up to 39.7% without compromising user agency. The collected dataset represents the first multimodal dataset that provides continuous visual, physiological, and operator's bilateral motion tracking of temporal affective state shifts during bimanual teleoperation. Our multimodal fusion model outperforms zero-shot baselines (Qwen, MiniCPM-V) in tracking temporal state dynamics. This real-world deployment offers a new human-centric framework that integrates visual, physiological, and motion tracking for physical human-robot interaction.

</details>


### [362] [HEROIC: Heterogeneous Evidential Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Identification and Cross-Robot Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19803)
*Mihir Chauhan,Aarav Jain,Addison Zucek,Manmeet Dang,Damon Conover,Aniket Bera*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HEROIC是一种去中心化异构空地多智能体开放词汇搜索协同框架，仅通过自然语言通信，基于传感器属性与尺度律实现动态角色分配，实验成功率84%，比基线快2-4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空地异构机器人团队适用于侦察、城市搜救、灾害响应等开放世界搜索任务，但两平台失效模式不同：空中机器人覆盖快却无法分辨高空下的小型或被遮挡目标，地面机器人能近距离识别目标却覆盖面积小。现有多语言任务团队要么预先固定角色，要么依赖手写能力标签由语言模型分配，导致团队无法判断任务过程中某资产何时不再有用。

Method: 提出HEROIC框架：1) 初始角色分配由传感器属性与尺度律推导，判断目标能否被高置信度检测，仅从任务自然语言提示即可计算飞行高度与扫描间距；2) 当计算高度低于安全飞行高度时，空中智能体自我重任务，从搜索者转为空中分诊、护航与地面智能体路径引导；3) 两机器人对搜索区域维护证据信念（正证据为方位射线，负证据为对数几率后验），并对任何到达进行近距离验证门控。

Result: 全栈实验中，HEROIC在全部6个场景中84%到达目标，而采用相同感知的视觉语言前沿基线、前沿搜索、割草机式与随机游走基线仅为35-54%，且HEROIC到达目标的时间快2-4倍。

Conclusion: HEROIC通过自然语言通信与基于尺度律的动态角色重任务机制，实现了异构空地团队在开放词汇搜索中的高效协同，显著优于现有基线的成功率与到达速度。

Abstract: Multi-agent heterogeneous air-ground robot teams are attractive for open world search, with applications for reconnaissance, urban search and rescue missions (USAR), disaster response and recovery, and hazardous environments. These two platforms have different failure modes: aerial robots cover ground quickly but cannot resolve small or occluded targets from altitude, while ground robots can identify objects-of-interest, such as people or hazardous objects, at close range but cover less area. Existing language-tasked teams either have roles fixed prior, or have a language model assign them from hand-written capability tags, so the team is unable to know when within a mission an asset is no longer useful. We present HEROIC, a decentralized heterogeneous multi-agent open-vocabulary search coordination framework that requires agents to communicate in natural language only. HEROIC's initial agent role assignment is derived from sensor properties and a scale law to determine whether targets can be detected with a high confidence. From the mission's natural language prompt alone, this law assigns aerial flight altitudes and sweep spacing. When this calculated height falls below the altitude for safe flight, aerial agents re-task themselves from searcher to aerial triage, escort, and route guide for ground agents. Both robots maintain an evidential belief over the search area (bearing rays for positive evidence, a log-odds posterior for negative evidence) and gate any arrival on close-range verification. In full-stack experiments, HEROIC reaches the target 84% of the time across all 6 scenes, compares to 35-54% for vision-language frontier baselines, frontier-based search, lawnmower, and random-walk running the same perception, all while being 2-4x sooner to arrive at the target.

</details>


### [363] [Vehicle Trajectory Prediction via Neural Fusion of Multiple EKF-Based Trajectory Candidates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19813)
*Seong-Jun Kim,Seung-Hyun Kong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出将Trajectron++的神经网络轨迹预测输出与基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的多轨迹候选进行后期融合的框架，在nuScenes数据集上将基线平均位移误差和最终位移误差分别降低13.7%和14.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶中预测周围车辆未来轨迹对碰撞风险评估和安全路径规划至关重要。现有神经网络预测器虽借助智能体历史、动态场景图和语义地图取得较好性能，但在加速、减速、转弯等特定运动模式下可能无法反映物理可行的轨迹，即缺乏物理约束导致预测不合理。

Method: 在后期阶段融合Trajectron++（神经网络轨迹预测器）的输出与基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）生成的多个轨迹候选，通过可学习的融合方式将物理模型候选与神经预测结果结合，且不修改基线架构。

Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，相比Trajectron++机器人基线，平均位移误差（ADE）降低13.7%，最终位移误差（FDE）降低14.6%。

Conclusion: 基于EKF的轨迹候选可通过学习式融合有效补充神经轨迹预测，在不改动基线架构的前提下提升预测的物理可行性与精度。

Abstract: Predicting the future trajectories of surrounding vehicles in autonomous driving is important for collision risk assessment and safe ego-vehicle path planning. Conventional neural network-based trajectory predictors typically achieve strong prediction performance by exploiting agent history, dynamic scene graphs, and semantic maps. However, in specific motion regimes such as acceleration, deceleration, and turning, these predictors may fail to reflect physically feasible trajectories. To address this issue, this study proposes a framework that fuses the output of Trajectron++, a neural network-based trajectory predictor, with extended Kalman filter (EKF)-based multiple trajectory candidates at a late stage. On the nuScenes dataset, the proposed method reduces the average displacement error and final displacement error of the Trajectron++ robot baseline by 13.7% and 14.6%, respectively, without modifying the baseline architecture. These results indicate that EKF-based trajectory candidates can effectively complement neural trajectory prediction through learned fusion.

</details>


### [364] [RotateIt! Fast and Reliable Single-Arm Garment Unfolding via Online-Adaptive Dynamic Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19817)
*Zeqing Zhang,Zuokun Xie,Ao Fang,Bin Dai,Zhengjie Shu,Yifeng Tang,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RotateIt!——首个以动态轴向旋转为核心操作原语的单臂衣物展开框架，可在紧凑工作空间内高效展开随机堆叠的衣物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 衣物展开是机器人下游任务的关键前提，但现有方法存在明显局限：准静态方法需要反复操作、效率低；动态方法主要依赖双臂甩动（bimanual flinging），对硬件要求高、适用范围受限。因此需要一个单臂、高效且能在紧凑空间内完成动态展开的新框架。

Method: 该方法采用自适应轴向旋转作为主要操作原语。从随机初始化的桌面配置出发，机器人选择一个对旋转有效的抓取点，将提起的衣物绕近似固定的锚点旋转，产生惯性张力以分离重叠层。核心组件包括：抓取排序器（grasp ranker）用于选择锚点；在线残差策略（online residual policy）用于自适应调整旋转幅度与速度，从而决定释放时机。

Result: 在已知与未知的仿真衣物及8件未见的真实衣物上，RotateIt! 相比准静态抓取放置方法，将三次尝试内的成功率提升44.0–61.0个百分点。仿真训练的策略可零样本迁移到现实世界，实现75.6%的成功率，首次尝试覆盖率提升41%，最终覆盖率提升26%。

Conclusion: RotateIt! 证明了动态轴向旋转作为单臂衣物展开操作原语的有效性，能够生成有利于后续任务的展开状态，并进一步支持无需人工重新整理的自主机器人折叠。

Abstract: Robotic garment unfolding is essential for downstream tasks, yet quasi-static methods require repeated actions, while existing dynamic approaches predominantly rely on bimanual flinging. We present RotateIt!, a single-arm framework that uses adaptive axial rotation for dynamic garment unfolding. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first unfolding framework to employ dynamic axial rotation as its primary manipulation primitive. From a randomly initialized tabletop configuration, the robot selects a rotation-effective grasp and rotates the lifted garment about an approximately fixed anchor, generating inertial tension that separates overlapping layers within a compact workspace. A grasp ranker selects the anchor, while an online residual policy adapts the rotation extent and speed, thereby determining the release timing. Across seen and unseen simulated garments and eight unseen real garments, RotateIt! improves success within three attempts by 44.0-61.0 percentage points over quasi-static pick-and-place. The simulation-trained policies transfer zero-shot to the real world, achieving 75.6% success, 41% higher first-attempt coverage, and 26% higher final coverage. The resulting states further enable autonomous robotic folding without manual rearrangement.

</details>


### [365] [TADreamer: Zero-Shot Language-Guided 3D Navigation for Terrestrial-Aerial Bimodal Robots via Video Imagination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19824)
*Xiangyu Li,Tiancheng Lai,Xijie Huang,Ruitian Pang,Siqi Shen,Juncheng Chen,Zaisheng Pan,Chao Xu,Fei Gao,Yanjun Cao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TADreamer是一个零样本框架，将视频想象导航锚定到实测几何，无需任务特定训练即可实现地空双模态机器人语言引导导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地空双模态机器人的语言引导导航需要选择匹配场景情境与任务意图的路线和运动模式。生成视频可表示此类运动序列，但从中恢复度量一致的导航参考存在困难，主要源于尺度模糊和轴向相关的几何畸变。

Method: 采用视觉语言模型将机载观测与指令转化为导航提示，筛选有效生成视频并在需重生成时提供纠正反馈；将选中视频重建为标注地/空模式的3D路点；两阶段标定先用视场约束初始化尺度估计，再通过将重建点云配准到实测几何来精化轴向相关尺度、旋转与平移；标定后的路点与模式标签引导融合实测几何的规划器执行。

Result: 在七个室内外场景中完成真实世界导航实验。每轮5个候选时，所有七个场景均在两轮内获得可用视频。在标定观测上，相比NavDreamer，平均绝对深度误差降低87.7%，平均绝对相对深度误差降低86.3%。

Conclusion: 该零样本框架可在无任务特定训练或微调条件下，将视频想象导航有效锚定到实测几何，显著提升深度估计精度并支持地空双模态真实导航。

Abstract: Language-guided navigation for terrestrial-aerial bimodal robots requires selecting routes and locomotion modes that match scene context and task intent. Generated videos can represent such motion sequences, but recovering metrically consistent navigation references from them is challenging because of scale ambiguity and axis-dependent geometric distortions. We present TADreamer, a zero-shot framework that grounds video-imagined navigation in measured geometry without task-specific training or fine-tuning. A vision-language model translates onboard observations and instructions into navigation prompts, selects valid generated videos, and provides corrective feedback when regeneration is needed. The selected video is reconstructed into 3D waypoints annotated with terrestrial or aerial modes. A two-stage calibration procedure uses field-of-view constraints to initialize scale estimation, then refines axis-dependent scales, rotation, and translation by registering the reconstructed point cloud to measured geometry. The calibrated waypoints and mode labels guide a planner that incorporates measured geometry for robot execution. Real-world experiments demonstrate navigation across seven indoor and outdoor scenarios. With five candidates per round, usable videos are obtained within two rounds in all seven scenarios. On the calibration observations, our method reduces mean absolute depth error by 87.7% and mean absolute relative depth error by 86.3% compared with NavDreamer.

</details>


### [366] [Improving Cross-embodiment Transfer in Latent Action Models with Action-Similarity Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19846)
*Maxime Alvarez,Renzo Caballero,Tatsuya Matsushima,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出用"动作相似度监督"训练潜动作模型(LAM)：让两个潜动作之间的相似度匹配对应真值机器人动作序列的相似度，从而免去预测具体动作、避免编码本体特性，在RoboTwin 2.0双臂跨本体迁移中显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人策略虽能从网络规模预训练获得视觉与语言能力，但演示数据采集代价高且与录制机器人绑定。潜动作模型（LAM）可从无动作视频中学习可跨本体共享的潜动作，但实际中存在两个问题：对背景视觉噪声敏感；不同机器人执行相同运动却被编码为不同潜动作。已有做法通过辅助损失从潜动作预测机器人动作，以关联潜动作空间与本体特定动作空间，本文希望探索同一标签的不同用法。

Method: 采用动作相似度监督：训练任意两个潜动作之间的相似度去匹配对应两段真值机器人动作序列的相似度。真值动作从不被LAM预测，因此潜动作无需编码本体细节。在RoboTwin 2.0上进行受控跨本体迁移评测：两个双臂机器人演示互不重叠的任务集，策略在所有演示上训练，每个机器人仅对另一个机器人演示过的任务做闭环评测；固定策略架构与超参、数据集和评测协议。对比变体包括：预测潜动作 vs 预测真值动作、相似度监督 vs 辅助真值动作预测损失，以及相似度在末端执行器运动 vs 关节空间运动上计算、损失是否跨两机器人比较潜动作。

Result: 在固定策略架构、超参、数据集与评测协议下，预测潜动作相比预测真值动作使跨本体成功率提升一倍以上。在给定相同真值动作的前提下，相似度监督的迁移效果优于LAM训练中预测真值动作的辅助损失。在末端执行器运动上计算相似度（而非关节空间运动），并让损失跨两台机器人比较潜动作，是本研究中效果最好的方案。

Conclusion: 动作相似度监督为跨本体潜动作学习提供了一条有效路径：通过只对齐相似度结构而非预测具体动作，潜动作空间摆脱本体特定性，配合末端执行器空间相似度与跨机器人对比，可显著提升跨本体策略迁移性能。

Abstract: As generalist robot policies gain vision and language from web-scale pretraining, demonstrations remain costly to collect and tied to the robot that recorded them. Latent action models (LAMs) address both by learning latent actions from action-free videos that can be shared across embodiments, however, in practice, LAMs are sensitive to background visual noise, and the same motion from two different robots may be encoded with different latents. One solution to the background visual noise is to add an auxiliary loss predicting the robot action from the latent action, further associating the latent action space to the embodiment specific robot action space. We study a different use of the same labels, through action-similarity supervision. The similarity between any two latent actions is trained to match the similarity of the two ground-truth robot action sequences. The ground-truth actions are never predicted by the LAM, so the latent action does not need to encode embodiment specifics. We evaluate cross-embodiment transfer on RoboTwin 2.0 in a controlled setup, two bimanual robots demonstrate disjoint task sets, a policy is trained on all the demonstrations, and each robot is evaluated closed-loop on the tasks only the other demonstrated. With the policy architecture and its hyperparameters, the dataset, and the evaluation protocol fixed, predicting latent actions instead of ground-truth actions more than doubles cross-embodiment success. Given the same ground-truth actions, similarity supervision transfers better than an auxiliary loss that predicts the ground-truth action during the LAM training. Computing the similarities on end-effector motion rather than joint-space motion, and letting the loss compare latent actions across the two robots, gives the best approach of the study.

</details>


### [367] [GR2PO: Group Relative Return Policy Optimization for Continuous Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19850)
*Pengqin Wang,Qiming Zhang,Shaojie Shen,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出无评论家（critic-free）强化学习框架 GR2PO，用于连续机器人控制，显著优于基于即时奖励的无评论家基线，并与先进 actor-critic 方法竞争力相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: actor-critic 架构虽广泛用于连续机器人控制，但需学习价值网络，带来额外训练开销，且价值估计的近似误差会影响策略学习；而无评论家的组相对策略优化方法虽更简洁，但在稠密奖励环境下直接用即时奖励优化策略，无法学习长期动作结果。

Method: GR2PO 从并行采集的轨迹中估计折扣回报，在每个 rollout 时间索引处进行组归一化，并使用相对优势与裁剪目标来更新策略。

Result: 在机器人控制仿真环境中实例化并部署至真实边缘设备：GR2PO 显著优于使用即时奖励的无评论家基线，与先进 actor-critic 方法性能相当；训练效率具竞争力；在 NVIDIA Jetson TX2 上的推理测试验证了边缘平台部署可行性；消融实验分析了并行组大小、回报估计方法与目标裁剪比例的影响。

Conclusion: GR2PO 是一种有效的无评论家强化学习框架，兼顾性能与训练效率，并可部署于边缘平台；论文被接收后将公开完整代码以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Actor-critic architecture has been widely used in continuous robot control. However, they rely on learning a value network, introducing additional computational overhead during training. Moreover, policy learning may also be affected by the approximation error of value estimation. Critic-free group relative policy optimization methods provide a simpler training approach by removing the need for a critic. However, they fail to learn long-term action outcomes when directly applying immediate rewards to policy optimization in dense-reward environments. To address these problems, we propose Group Relative Return Policy Optimization (GR2PO), a critic-free reinforcement learning framework for continuous robot control. GR2PO estimates the discounted returns from the parallelly collected trajectories, performs group normalization at each rollout time index, and uses relative advantages and clipped targets to update the policy. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, we instantiate it on robot control simulation environments and deploy the model to a real-world edge device. The results show that GR2PO significantly outperforms critic-free baselines that use immediate rewards and performs competitively against state-of-the-art actor-critic methods. Furthermore, GR2PO demonstrates competitive training efficiency. Inference tests on NVIDIA Jetson TX2 demonstrate the feasibility of deploying the learned policies on edge platforms. Further ablation experiments analyze the effects of parallel group size, return estimation methods, and target clipping ratio on learning performance. To support follow-up research, we will make the complete code publicly available after the paper is accepted, including the framework implementation, experimental configuration, and training and evaluation scripts.

</details>


### [368] [Feeling Terrain Before Crossing: World Models for Off-Road Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19863)
*E-In Son,Dong-Wook Kim,Ji-Hoon Hwang,Kangsun Lee,Jisung Bae,Jung-Taak Kim,Seung-Woo Seo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Feel-WM，首个以本体感受为条件、同时预测视觉场景与物理未来（未来本体感受状态与失败风险）的越野导航世界模型，并据此规划路径，在真实数据与仿真中优于纯视觉世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越野导航依赖机器人-地形交互，预测不仅要涵盖相机所见，还需涵盖机器人所感（打滑、倾斜、抖动等），而现有以场景为中心的世界模型无法预测这些物理动力学，仅靠视觉预测不足以支撑安全规划。

Method: 以本体感受作为输入条件，构建世界模型 Feel-WM，预测视觉场景与物理未来；物理未来表示为未来本体感受状态与失败风险，二者均从机器人自身经验中学习、无需人工标注；规划器将物理未来与场景一同推演，并在可分离评分中将预测失败风险与目标相似度加权。

Result: 在真实越野数据与仿真中，Feel-WM 在开环规划与闭环崎岖地形导航上均优于纯视觉导航世界模型，覆盖轮式与足式平台；部署于山地小径的 Husky 上可机载规划、预测前方崎岖地面并绕行，完成端到端策略失败的路线。

Conclusion: 将本体感受引入世界模型并显式预测物理未来，能显著提升越野导航的规划质量与鲁棒性，且无需人工标签，具备跨平台与真实机载部署的可行性。

Abstract: Navigation world models plan by foresight, predicting the future that each candidate action sequence produces and selecting the best, rather than mapping observations to actions directly. Unlike urban settings where a predicted scene is a sufficient proxy, off-road navigation hinges on the robot--terrain interaction, so the prediction must cover not only what the camera will see but what the robot will feel. However, existing scene-focused models do not predict how much the robot will slip, tilt or shake along a planned trajectory. Proprioception captures these dynamics directly and, when used as input, improves the prediction of the physical future. We present Feel-WM, the first off-road navigation world model that conditions on proprioception and predicts what the robot will feel alongside what the camera will see. The physical future takes the form of a future proprioceptive state and a failure risk, both learned from the robot's own experience without human labels. The planner rolls out the physical future alongside the scene and weighs the predicted failure risk against goal similarity in a separable score. Experiments on real off-road data and in simulation demonstrate that Feel-WM outperforms visual-only navigation world models in open-loop planning and closed-loop rough-terrain navigation across wheeled and legged platforms. Deployed on a Husky on mountain trails, Feel-WM plans onboard, predicts rough ground ahead and steers around it, completing courses that an end-to-end policy fails.

</details>


### [369] [Learning Reliable Parking Policies via Offline Reinforcement Learning with Quantized Action Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19894)
*Zewei Yang,Zengqi Peng,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于航点级离线强化学习的交互感知自动泊车框架，在CARLA仿真中取得最高泊车成功率并可泛化到未见车位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市自动泊车是常规但安全攸关的任务。杂乱、弱结构的泊车空间以及周边车辆带来的交互不确定性，使可靠的动作生成十分困难。

Method: 1) 构建专用泊车数据集：基于分层专家轨迹并做旋转航点增强，同时覆盖非交互与交互场景；2) 策略以紧凑状态表示为条件，将LiDAR障碍物特征通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）适配到目标位姿；3) 采用状态条件化的tokenizer将连续航点序列量化为离散动作token，并在其上执行保守Q学习（CQL）以抑制对低支撑动作的价值高估。

Result: 在高保真CARLA仿真器中开展大量闭环实验，所提框架在所有基线中取得最高泊车成功率，并能可靠迁移到未见过的泊车位。

Conclusion: 航点级离线强化学习结合交互感知状态表示与保守价值学习，可有效提升自动泊车的成功率与泛化能力。

Abstract: Parking is a routine yet safety-critical task for autonomous vehicles operating in urban environments. However, cluttered and weakly structured parking spaces, compounded by the interactive uncertainty from surrounding vehicles, hinder reliable maneuver generation. To address these challenges, we develop a waypoint-level offline reinforcement learning framework for interaction-aware autonomous parking. Specifically, a dedicated parking dataset is constructed from hierarchical expert rollouts with rotational waypoint augmentation, covering both non-interactive scenarios and interactive ones. The policy is then conditioned on a compact state representation, in which LiDAR-based obstacle features are adapted to the target pose via feature-wise linear modulation. A state-conditioned tokenizer further quantizes continuous waypoint sequences into discrete action tokens, over which conservative Q-learning is performed to suppress value overestimation on poorly supported actions. Extensive closed-loop experiments are conducted in the high-fidelity CARLA simulator. The proposed framework attains the highest parking success rate among all baselines and transfers reliably to unseen parking slots.

</details>


### [370] [Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19906)
*So Kuroki,Yujin Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将完整闭环策略实现视为可复用的执行经验：编码智能体在源任务上生成并迭代优化策略代码并归档，新任务中借助归档代码与演示生成并优化策略。RoboCasa 四个源任务平均成功率由 28.3% 提升至 64.2%；九个目标任务平均成功率为无参考 45.2%、初始源码参考 41.5%、优化源码参考 57.0%，优化参考在三轮运行中均优于初始参考，平均增益 15.6 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环机器人策略涉及观测处理、状态管理与情境分支，人工设计调优成本高。编码智能体已支持控制代码生成与优化，但尚不清楚在源任务上改进后的实现能否迁移支持新任务的策略获取。

Method: 把完整闭环实现当作可复用执行经验。源任务：编码智能体基于少量成功演示生成策略代码，并利用仿真反馈迭代改进，经验证集选择的实现存入软件归档。新任务：智能体结合归档实现、目标演示与执行反馈生成并改进策略；最终策略冻结后执行，不再调用模型。

Result: RoboCasa 四个源任务迭代优化使平均成功率从 28.3% 升至 64.2%。九个目标任务三轮独立运行的平均成功率为：无参考 45.2%，初始源码参考 41.5%，优化源码参考 57.0%。优化参考在三轮中均优于初始参考，九任务平均增益 15.6 个百分点；但按运行平均，初始参考在两个目标任务上仍更优。

Conclusion: 经过执行优化的软件可作为获取新策略的有效资源。但初始参考在部分目标任务上仍具优势，说明迁移收益并非普遍一致。

Abstract: Closed-loop robot policies require observation processing, state management, and situation-dependent branching, making them costly to design and tune manually. Although coding agents increasingly support control-code generation and optimization, it remains unclear whether implementations improved on source tasks also support policy acquisition for new tasks. We study this question by treating complete closed-loop implementations as reusable execution experience. For each source task, a coding agent generates policy code from a few successful demonstrations and iteratively improves it using simulation feedback. The validation-selected implementations are retained in a software archive. For new tasks, the agent generates and improves policies using archived implementations, target demonstrations, and execution feedback. The resulting policy is then frozen and executes without further model calls. Across four source tasks in RoboCasa, iterative optimization increases mean success from 28.3% to 64.2%. Across nine target tasks and three independent runs, mean success is 45.2% without references, 41.5% with initial source code, and 57.0% with optimized source code. Optimized references outperform initial references in all three runs on the nine-task average, with a mean gain of 15.6 percentage points. These results demonstrate the value of execution-improved software as a resource for acquiring new policies in this setting, although initial references remain better on two target tasks when averaged across runs.

</details>


### [371] [Distributed Model Predictive Control with Connectivity-based Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19912)
*Jorit Geurts,Danilo Saccani,Melanie N. Zeilinger,Andrea Carron*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种分布式模型预测控制(DMPC)框架，通过为每个智能体分配局部"连通性契约"(connectivity contract)区域，在保证团队连通性的同时实现可扩展的实时分布式控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数DMPC方案假设通信网络保持连通，而未主动强制维持连通性。但通常的连通性数学条件是非凸的，且涉及所有智能体两两之间的耦合，与可扩展的分布式实时控制器不兼容，因此主动保证连通性十分困难。

Method: 为每个智能体分配一个连通性契约，即规定其在整个预测时域内预测位置可位于的局部区域。契约设计保证只要每个智能体留在自己的契约内，整个团队就保持连通。基于维持的契约图，智能体仅通过与直接邻居的一次信息交换即可构建自己的契约，之后各智能体独立求解各自的优化问题。

Result: 证明了所得闭环系统能够保持连通性、避免碰撞并满足局部状态与输入约束。在微型自主类车机器人上通过仿真与硬件实验验证了该方法。

Conclusion: 该框架在无需全局非凸连通性约束的情况下，实现了可扩展的分布式实时连通性保证，并通过仿真和硬件实验得到验证。

Abstract: Teams of mobile robots rely on continuous communication with their neighbors for coordination, yet most distributed model predictive control (DMPC) schemes assume the communication network stays connected rather than actively enforcing it. Adding such a guarantee is hard since the usual mathematical condition for connectivity is nonconvex and links every agent to every other, which is incompatible with a scalable distributed real-time controller. We propose a DMPC framework in which each agent is assigned a connectivity contract: a local region prescribing where its predicted positions may lie over the prediction horizon. The contracts are designed so that, as long as every agent stays within its own contract, the team is guaranteed to remain connected. Given the maintained contract graph, an agent builds its contract from a single exchange with its immediate neighbors, after which every agent solves its own optimization problem independently. We prove that the resulting closed-loop system maintains connectivity, avoids collisions, and respects local state and input constraints. Simulation and hardware experiments on miniature autonomous car-like robots demonstrate the approach.

</details>


### [372] [Co-VLA: Consensus-based Federated Training for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19923)
*Haolong Li,Guner Dilsad Er,Michael Muehlebach,Joerg Stueckler*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Co-VLA，用ADMM共识优化实现联邦视觉-语言-动作模型训练，支持全模型训练与参数高效微调，性能接近集中式训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型随规模扩展性能提升，但机器人数据天然分散于不同机器人、任务与地点，集中式收集成本高甚至不可行。联邦学习可在去中心化数据上训练，但直接用于VLA需解决各客户端数据分布异构的问题。

Method: Co-VLA将共识优化引入联邦VLA训练，采用交替方向乘子法（ADMM）。同一算法既支持全模型训练，也支持参数高效微调，并兼容固定秩与秩自适应适配器。名称体现共识（consensus）与协作（collaboration）：不同本地机器人数据集的客户端在不上传数据的前提下协同训练共享模型。

Result: 实验表明，无论在全模型训练还是参数高效微调设置下，Co-VLA都能达到与集中式训练相当的性能。

Conclusion: Co-VLA为异构机器人客户端数据下的联邦VLA训练提供了统一且有效的方案，在保护数据隐私的同时实现与集中式训练相当的性能。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot learning, with performance improving as models and datasets scale. Scaling robot data collection, however, remains challenging because data are naturally distributed across robots, tasks, and locations, making centralization costly or impractical. Federated learning offers a way to train on decentralized robot data, but applying it to VLAs requires accounting for heterogeneous robot client data distributions. We present Co-VLA, which applies consensus optimization using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers~(ADMM) to federated VLA training. We show that the same algorithm supports both full-model training and parameter-efficient fine-tuning with both fixed-rank and rank-adaptive adapters. The name Co-VLA reflects both consensus and collaboration: clients with different local robot datasets collaboratively train a shared model without sharing their data. Our experiments demonstrate that Co-VLA achieves performance comparable to centralized training in both full-model training and parameter-efficient fine-tuning settings.

</details>


### [373] [Execution-Aware Pre-Execution Ranking for Grasp-Conditioned Robotic Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19946)
*Tianyuan Liu,Rutherford Agbeshi Patamia,Benjamin Champion,Richard Dazeley,Akansel Cosgun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文将抓取-放置中的“放置”建模为执行前的候选排序问题，用类型化目标条件点云与位姿描述符进行分层预测，在自有数据集上显著优于cuMotion，并可零样本迁移到另一机械臂平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何上可行的放置位置并不一定能顺利执行，因为所选抓取会改变末端执行器所需位姿、碰撞几何以及搬运运动。因此需要在规划前对候选进行筛选与排序，以避免执行阶段的失败。

Method: 将放置形式化为预执行排序问题：对给定的抓取-放置候选在规划前打分。模型输入为类型化、目标条件的点云，并结合三种位姿描述符，采用分层预测头：先预测规划成功，再预测在规划成功条件下的执行成功。评估采用30个物体、1,235个场景的数据集，使用按场景组留出的划分方式。

Result: 三随机种子的top-1成功率：联合选择在覆盖测试组上为85.63 +/- 1.08%，固定目标排序为79.84 +/- 0.16%。冻结seed-42检查点下，联合排序top-1从72.84%提升到85.78%（对比full-pool cuMotion），固定目标排序从59.65%提升到79.67%。冻结迁移到xArm7/MoveIt无需xArm专用重训练。27个锁定案例中13个端到端完成（48.15%）；通过Top-5预检并开始执行的16个案例中13个成功（81.25%）。候选级部署可行性预测召回81.25%、特异度85.20%、平衡准确率83.23%。

Conclusion: 执行前的候选排序可有效提升抓取-放置任务的实际执行成功率，分层建模规划与执行成功具有实用价值，且模型具备跨平台零样本迁移能力。

Abstract: A geometrically valid placement can still be difficult to execute because the selected grasp changes the required end-effector pose, collision geometry, and transport motion. Placement is formulated as a pre-execution ranking problem in which supplied grasp-placement candidates are scored before planning. The model combines a typed target-conditioned point cloud with three pose descriptors and hierarchical heads for planning success and execution success conditioned on planning. On a 30-object, 1,235-scene dataset with scene-group-held-out splits, three-seed top-1 success on covered test groups reaches 85.63 +/- 1.08% for joint selection and 79.84 +/- 0.16% for fixed-target ranking. For the designated frozen seed-42 checkpoint, top-1 success improves from 72.84% to 85.78% over full-pool cuMotion for joint ranking and from 59.65% to 79.67% for fixed-target ranking. Frozen transfer to xArm7/MoveIt requires no xArm-specific retraining. Across 27 locked cases, 13 complete end to end (48.15%). Of the 16 cases that pass Top-5 preflight and begin execution, 13 succeed (81.25%). Candidate-level deployment-feasibility prediction reaches 81.25% recall, 85.20% specificity, and 83.23% balanced accuracy.

</details>


### [374] [LapaTrack-3D: 6 DoF pre-operative shape tracking for laparoscopic surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19954)
*Jingwei Song,Javid Hussain Jakir,Ray Zhang,Wenwei Zhang,Hao Zhou,Xiaomeng Xian,Maani Ghaffari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出LapaTrack-3D，一种用于单目腹腔镜手术的实时6自由度跟踪算法，实现术中视频与术前CT数据的对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腹腔镜手术缺乏触觉反馈且组织不透明，难以准确定位目标器官内部解剖结构，因此需要将术中视频与术前数据进行6自由度对齐。

Method: 基于ORB-SLAM2框架进行四项改进：(1)利用原始3D形状快速初始化单目模式；(2)采用伪分割策略分离目标器官与背景；(3)将3D形状作为几何先验融入位姿图优化；(4)改进MSRCP算法用于复杂光照下的图像增强。

Result: 体内与离体实验验证LapaTrack-3D具有稳健的3D跟踪能力，能有效应对光照差、快速运动、视野外、部分可见及器官-背景相对运动等挑战；1280×720像素视频处理速率达13 Hz。

Conclusion: LapaTrack-3D实现了实时、稳健的单目腹腔镜6自由度跟踪，可为术前数据与术中视频对齐提供有效方案。

Abstract: This work proposes a real-time 6 Degree-of-Freedom (6 DoF) tracking algorithm for monocular laparoscopic surgery. It provides alignment between intra-operative video and pre-operative data (e.g., CT). The 6 DoF tracking offers a solution for accurately locating the internal anatomy of the target organ despite the lack of tactile feedback and transparency. The ORB-SLAM2 framework is adopted and modified for prior-based 3D tracking with four major modifications. First, the primitive 3D shape is used for fast initialization of the ORB-SLAM2 monocular mode. Second, a pseudo-segmentation strategy is employed to separate the target organ from the background for tracking. Third, the 3D shape is incorporated as a geometric prior in its pose graph optimization. Fourth, the Multi-Scale Retinex with Chromaticity Preservation (MSRCP) algorithm is leveraged and modified for image enhancement in challenging illumination scenarios. In-vivo and ex-vivo experiments validate that LapaTrack-3D provides robust 3D tracking and effectively handles typical challenges such as poor illumination, fast motion, out-of-field-of-view scenarios, partial visibility, and ``organ-background'' relative motion. LapaTrack-3D achieves a processing rate of 13 Hz for 1280*720 pixel video.

</details>


### [375] [Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19962)
*Tianyuan Liu,Rutherford Agbeshi Patamia,Benjamin Champion,Akansel Cosgun,Richard Dazeley*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究把已抓取书籍放入狭窄书架的接触丰富控制问题，提出“几何标称控制器 + 残差PPO”的混合方案：标称控制维持结构化插入与就位，残差策略提供有界局部修正并决定释放时机。仿真中成功率由37.89%提升至98.50%，实机xArm7上由26.7%提升至63.3%，15个差异条件下赢下13个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将已抓取书籍放入狭窄书架时，毫米级位姿误差即可使几何上可行的接近变为卡阻、释放失败或未完全就位。作者聚焦于抓取与全局接近之后的最后阶段，探究控制权限应如何在已知几何与学习行为之间分配。

Method: 保留标称任务空间控制器负责结构化插入与就位；残差PPO提供有界局部修正并决定何时释放；仅对短暂的开—撤—再闭合过渡采用脚本化控制。最终硬件策略通过部署匹配的仿真评估验证，覆盖512个固定条件、三次独立训练。

Result: 仿真中残差控制成功率98.50%（样本标准差0.23个百分点），标称控制为37.89%。xArm7实机30个匹配条件下60次试验：成功率由26.7%提升至63.3%，失败由22次降至11次，并在15个两控制器有差异的匹配条件中赢下13个。鲁棒性测试显示初始化扰动达1.5倍时性能仍高于87%，但极小间隙暴露了局部修正的几何极限。

Conclusion: 结果支持混合设计：由几何保持可靠的任务结构，将学习集中于固定规则难以处理的接触敏感行为。该范式在接触丰富的精细操作中兼顾了稳定性与适应性。

Abstract: Placing a grasped book into a tight shelf is a compact but difficult contact-rich control problem: millimetre-scale pose error can turn a geometrically valid approach into jamming, failed release, or incomplete seating. We study this final phase after grasp acquisition and global approach, and ask how control authority should be divided between known geometry and learned behaviour. Our method retains a nominal task-space controller for structured insertion and seating, while residual PPO supplies bounded local corrections and decides when to release. Only the brief open-retreat-reclose transition is scripted. For the final policy used on hardware, a deployment-matched simulation evaluation over 512 fixed conditions yields 98.50 percent mean success (0.23 percentage-point sample SD) across three independent training runs, compared with 37.89 percent for nominal control. On the physical xArm7, 60 trials over 30 matched conditions show the same qualitative advantage: residual control raises success from 26.7 percent to 63.3 percent, reduces failures from 22 to 11, and wins 13 of the 15 matched conditions in which the two controllers differ. Robustness tests show that performance remains above 87 percent under initialization perturbations up to 1.5x, while very tight clearances expose the geometric limit of local correction. These results support a hybrid design in which geometry preserves reliable task structure and learning is concentrated on the contact-sensitive behaviour that fixed rules handle poorly.

</details>


### [376] [MaskHarness-WAM: Instance-Grounded Harnessing for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19974)
*Zitai Huang,Taiyi Su,Jian Zhu,Jianjun Zhang,Chong Ma,Tianbin Liu,Weiyi Lu,Yi Xu,Hanli Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MaskHarness-WAM，一种基于实例目标的长期操作框架，通过目标掩码连接高层任务规划与底层操作策略，并借助视觉反馈实现子任务调度与连续执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期机器人操作面临多物体外观相同且需按序操作时，仅依赖有限视野（limited-horizon）的操作策略难以判断应操作哪个实例以及何时切换任务阶段，需要高层规划与底层控制的有效衔接机制。

Method: 系统通过目标掩码（target masks）连接高层任务规划与底层操作策略；在每个子任务边界持续重新观测环境，生成并验证新的目标掩码，更新提供给底层策略的实例级空间条件；依据子任务完成状态的验证结果切换目标实例，推进操作进程。

Result: 在真实机器人平台上的实验表明，MaskHarness-WAM在顺序多物体操作任务上显著优于有限视野策略。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效将局部操作技能扩展为可靠的长期执行，验证了基于实例掩码的规划-控制衔接机制在长期操作任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires not only stable local visuomotor control, but also continuous target tracking and reliable task progress assessment throughout execution. This challenge becomes particularly critical when multiple objects share identical appearances and must be manipulated in a prescribed order. In such scenarios, relying solely on a limited-horizon manipulation policy is often insufficient to determine which instance should be operated on and when the task should transition to the next stage. To address this challenge, we propose MaskHarness-WAM, an instance-grounded harness for long-horizon manipulation. The proposed system connects high-level task planning with low-level manipulation policies through target masks, while leveraging visual feedback for subtask scheduling and continuous execution. Since each subtask corresponds to a different target instance, the low-level policy requires a newly established initial target mask under the updated scene at each subtask transition. The harness continuously re-observes the environment, generates, and verifies the target mask at subtask boundaries, thereby updating the instance-level spatial condition provided to the low-level policy. Furthermore, the system advances the manipulation process by switching target instances according to the verified completion status of each subtask. Experiments on a real robot platform demonstrate that MaskHarness-WAM substantially outperforms limited-horizon policies on sequential multi-object manipulation, showing its effectiveness in extending local manipulation skills to reliable long-horizon execution.

</details>


### [377] [Compliance for Free: Learning Identifiable Impedance via Bilateral Teleoperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19976)
*Harsha Guda,Adrià Colomé,Carme Torras*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出用四通道双边遥操作消除"意图平衡位置"与"刚度"的不可辨识性,以关节力矩回归得到零标注成本的逐时刻方向相关刚度标签,微调VLA使策略同时输出位姿与刚度;在Franka Research 3擦拭任务中,五个策略中唯一能按指令改变接触力(6.4N→9.1N)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型只告诉机器人"往哪动",不告诉它"用多大力"。接触丰富任务依赖柔顺性(compliance)这一第二量,但尚无广泛使用的示教接口能记录它。根本障碍在于可辨识性:实际位姿与测得力无法分离操作者的意图平衡位置与刚度,因此VR控制器、SpaceMouse、手持夹爪在原理上都无法提供柔顺性监督。已有输出柔顺性的策略则依赖人工指定任务结构、特权仿真接触状态或专用力/触觉硬件。

Method: 采用四通道双边遥操作,把主臂作为"意图平衡位置"的独立测量,从而利用机械臂已有的关节力矩传感,通过回归使逐轴刚度可辨识。由此获得逐时间步、方向相关的柔顺性标签,标注成本为零。再用这些标签微调VLA模型,使其在输出位姿的同时输出刚度。

Result: 在Franka Research 3的擦拭任务上,对比五种策略,本文方法是唯一能在指令要求"用力擦"而非"正常擦"时改变接触力的策略:接触力RMS从6.4N(正常)升至9.1N(用力),Cohen's d = 0.89,p = 0.023。

Conclusion: 四通道双边遥操作能直接消除柔顺性标签的歧义,以零标注成本产生可辨识的逐轴刚度监督信号,使VLA具备指令可调的接触力控制能力,为接触丰富任务提供了无需专用硬件的柔顺性示教与学习范式。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models tell a robot where to move, but not how hard to push. Contact-rich tasks depend on that second quantity, compliance, yet no widely used demonstration interface records it. The obstacle is identifiability as realized pose and measured force cannot separate the operator's intended equilibrium from their stiffness, so VR controllers, SpaceMouse and handheld grippers cannot supply compliance supervision even in principle. Prior compliance-output policies work around this with hand-specified task structure, privileged simulation contact state, or dedicated force and tactile hardware. Four-channel bilateral teleoperation removes the ambiguity directly by using the leader arm as a separate measurement of the intended equilibrium, making per-axis stiffness identifiable by regression using only the joint-torque sensing already on the manipulator. This yields per-timestep, direction-dependent compliance labels at zero annotation cost, which we use to fine-tune a VLA to emit stiffness alongside pose. On a Franka Research 3 wiping task, ours is the only policy of five whose contact force changes when the instruction asks for a firm wipe rather than a normal one (6.4N (normal) to 9.1N (firm) RMS, Cohen's d = 0.89, p = 0.023

</details>


### [378] [DR-MPC: Fast and Feasible Dynamics-Relaxed Model-Predictive Control for Legged Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20035)
*Run Wang,Alapati Tuerxun,Shuo Liu,Wei Xiao,Ján Drgoňa,Yilin Mo,Liang Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出动力学松弛模型预测控制（DR-MPC）及定制内点法求解器，通过将等式与仿射输入约束转为二次惩罚、仅保留盒约束，得到块箭头Hessian的QP，利用Schur补消除状态与仿射输出方向，仅对约简控制系统进行分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升腿足机器人MPC的在线优化可行性与求解效率：在构造上保证可行性，同时结合接触感知输入参数化，减少求解规模并加速端到端计算。

Method: DR-MPC将动力学等式约束与仿射输入约束移入二次惩罚项，仅保留非空盒约束，形成盒约束二次规划；该QP具有块箭头Hessian结构，可通过Schur补消除状态与仿射输出方向；求解器在摆动力消除与接触对齐移动分块后，仅对约简后的控制系统进行因式分解。

Result: 在相同DR-MPC表述下，该方法相较HPIPM中位端到端MPC加速16.0倍，相较OSQP加速4.4倍，仿真中运动性能相当；机载MPC端到端时间中位数为4.4 ms，并在Unitree Go1四足机器人上完成验证。

Conclusion: DR-MPC与定制IPM求解器在保持运动性能的同时显著提升腿足机器人MPC求解速度，具备机载实时应用的可行性；开源代码将于论文发表后提供。

Abstract: This paper presents dynamics-relaxed model predictive control (DR-MPC), a novel MPC formulation for legged locomotion, and a tailored interior-point method (IPM) solver. The formulation combines online optimization feasibility by construction with a contact-aware input parameterization. DR-MPC moves the dynamics equality and affine input constraints into quadratic penalties and retains only nonempty box constraints. The resulting box-constrained quadratic program (QP) has a block-arrow Hessian that enables the state and affine-output directions to be eliminated through a Schur complement. The solver factors only the reduced control system after swing-force elimination and contact-aligned move blocking. For the evaluated implementations using the same DR-MPC formulation, our method achieves median end-to-end MPC speedups of $16.0\times$ over HPIPM and $4.4\times$ over OSQP, with comparable locomotion performance in simulation. DR-MPC achieves a median onboard MPC end-to-end time of $4.4$ ms and is validated on a Unitree Go1 quadruped. Open-source code will be made available after publication.

</details>


### [379] [Mechanical Precision Weeding with a Quadruped Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20048)
*Ruben Beumer,Tom Janssen,René van de Molengraft,Duarte Antunes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于小型四足机器人（Spot）的机械除草方案，在机器人末端刚性安装带铣刀的除草工具，通过腿部驱动实现工具运动，并集成自主除草软件系统，在室内外验证了概念原型的精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学除草因杂草抗性上升和环境影响而日益不可持续；机械除草虽避免化学问题，但通常依赖大型机械，导致土壤压实。亟需一种兼具低土壤压实、易自动化、可扩展性的替代方案。

Method: 采用Boston Dynamics Spot四足机器人，刚性安装末端带铣刀的定制除草工具；通过驱动机器人腿部、保持足端静止来利用机器人本体的自由度实现工具运动；开发支持自主除草的软件架构并整合所需组件。

Result: 在室内与室外环境中对当前概念原型的精度和效率进行了分析，并给出了提升系统精度与效率的后续工作建议。

Conclusion: 基于小型移动机器人的机械除草方案可减少土壤压实、简化自动化并提升可扩展性，概念验证具备可行性，但精度与效率仍需进一步优化。

Abstract: Herbicide-based weed control is increasingly unsustainable due to rising weed resistance and the adverse environmental impacts of chemical use. While mechanical weed control avoids these drawbacks, it is typically implemented using large machines that cause soil compaction. We propose a novel alternative based on small mobile robots for mechanical weeding. Compared with existing automated mechanical weeding approaches, the proposed method offers reduced soil compaction, simpler automation, and improved scalability. Our solution involves a Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped robot equipped with a custom weed removal tool featuring a milling bit at its end. The tool is rigidly attached to the robot and uses the degrees of freedom of the robot base by actuating the legs, while keeping the feet stationary. We develop a software architecture that enables autonomous weed removal and integrate this system with all other required components. We analyze the accuracy and efficiency of the current proof of concept both in an indoor and outdoor environment and provide recommendations for future work to make the system more accurate and efficient.

</details>


### [380] [FlipToSee: A Probabilistic Stable Placement Prior for Active Visual Exploration via Regrasping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20078)
*Chang Shu,Sushil Samuel Dinesh,Shinkyu Park*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 FlipToSee 概率框架，将稳定放置预测参数化为 S² 上的单位支撑法向，用 von Mises–Fisher 混合密度网络建模多模态分布，并解耦模式多样性与物理鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动视觉探索桌面物体常需将未知静止物体重新定向到不同稳定支撑面以暴露被遮挡表面。若无物理穷举搜索，难以识别此类放置；且稳定放置本质多模态，传统 6-DoF 回归对平移与平面内偏航建模会引入额外歧义。

Method: 从单视图点云学习概率放置先验。以 S² 上的单位支撑法向参数化放置，消除表示歧义；用 von Mises–Fisher 混合密度网络建模多模态条件分布；从混合分量中确定性提取紧凑候选集，并用候选对齐监督训练的辅助头进行鲁棒性感知重排序。

Result: 仿真中同分布物体首次提议成功率达 98.4%，分布外形状 95.3%，零样本迁移至家用 YCB 物体 90.0%；并在实体机器人上结合抓取与运动规划用于探索性重抓取。

Conclusion: FlipToSee 通过消除表示歧义并解耦模式多样性与物理鲁棒性，实现了高成功率的多模态稳定放置预测，并验证了从仿真到实体机器人的零样本迁移可行性。

Abstract: Active visual exploration of tabletop objects often requires reorienting an unknown resting object onto a different stable support face to expose occluded surfaces. To identify such placements without exhaustive physical search, we learn a probabilistic placement prior from a single-view point cloud. Stable placement prediction is inherently multimodal, and conventional 6-DoF regression introduces further ambiguity by modeling translation and in-plane yaw. We therefore propose FlipToSee, a probabilistic framework that removes this representational ambiguity by parameterizing placements as unit support normals on $S^2$ while modeling their multimodal conditional distribution via a von Mises--Fisher mixture density network. To decouple mode diversity from physical robustness, FlipToSee deterministically extracts a compact candidate set from the mixture components and applies robustness-aware reranking using an auxiliary head trained with candidate-aligned supervision. In simulation, FlipToSee achieves $98.4\%$ first-proposal success on in-distribution objects, $95.3\%$ on out-of-distribution shapes, and $90.0\%$ under zero-shot transfer to household YCB objects. We further demonstrate the learned placement prior on a physical robot by integrating it with grasp and motion planning for exploratory regrasping.

</details>


### [381] [Graph-Based Design of Soft Grippers with Multi-Objective Quality-Diversity Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20087)
*Andre Farinha,Ge Shi,Harry Bowman,Brendan Tidd,David Howard,Josh Pinskier*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究提出基于图的设计空间表示与多目标、多样性驱动的遗传优化框架，用于软体夹爪设计；通过在多个抓取场景下优化，发现任务多样性可促使设计涌现出对未见物体与接触条件的泛化能力，且比任务专用方案更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨多样物体的有效操作在农业收获、实验室与家庭自动化等应用中至关重要。软体机器人的固有柔顺性适合此类任务，但设计能在不同任务间泛化的夹爪仍很困难：连续体力学设计空间庞大，且易对特定场景过拟合。

Method: 提出用于表示软体结构与机构的图基设计空间，并结合多目标、多样性驱动的遗传优化框架，在设计过程中显式促进解的多样性。优化中使用多个抓取场景，研究任务多样性如何影响对未见物体与接触条件的泛化能力。

Result: 在足够多样的抓取案例集合上进行优化，可得到具有涌现泛化能力的设计；在新场景中相较任务专用解表现出更好的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 多样性驱动优化为通用软体夹爪提供了一条有原则的路径，契合软体机器人可适应的特性。

Abstract: Effective manipulation across diverse objects is critical for applications ranging from agricultural harvesting to laboratory and domestic automation. While the inherent compliance of soft robotics is well suited to this challenge, designing grippers that generalize across tasks remains difficult due to the vast design space of continuum mechanics and the risk of overfitting to specific scenarios.
  We propose a graph-based design space for representing soft structures and mechanisms, coupled with a multi-objective, diversity-driven genetic optimization framework that explicitly promotes solution variety throughout the design process. Using multiple grasping scenarios during optimization, we study how task diversity influences the emergence of generalization to unseen objects and contact conditions.
  Our results show that optimization over a sufficiently diverse set of grasping cases leads to designs with emergent generalization, exhibiting improved robustness compared to task-specific solutions on novel scenarios. These findings suggest that diversity-driven optimization offers a principled pathway toward general-purpose soft grippers, aligned with the adaptable nature of soft robotics.

</details>


### [382] [Safety-Critical Scenanrio Emerges from Initial Scene](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20103)
*Yin Wu,Jiarong Wei,Carl Esselborn,Shubham Phoolari,Ahmed Abouelazm,Daniel Slieter,J. Marius Zöllner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出AdvScene，将安全关键驾驶场景生成重新定义为"初始场景初始化"问题，利用条件潜扩散模型两阶段训练生成更易演化出关键交互的真实初始场景，在Waymo数据集上显著提升了自车责任碰撞与TTC<3s事件的发生率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全关键场景生成多基于驾驶数据的初始场景，仅操纵周围智能体行为，这限制了可发现失效的空间：驾驶数据本身缺乏有意义的交互机会（如Waymo Open Motion Dataset中20.44%切片的自车静止，30.39%初始帧10米内无交通参与者）。

Method: 将安全关键场景生成建模为初始化问题；提出AdvScene——条件潜扩散模型，两阶段训练：先在自然驾驶数据上预训练，再用强化学习对对抗智能体生成分支进行后训练，反馈来自闭环仿真器rollout；以自车行驶位移为条件防止自车静止，并直接用不可微的安全关键指标通过RL微调诱导关键性。

Result: 在Waymo数据集上，针对12种自车与交通策略组合的实验表明，AdvScene显著提高了自车责任碰撞事件与TTC<3s事件的发生率。

Conclusion: 通过对初始场景生成进行学习而非仅操纵智能体行为，可直接生成更易演化出安全关键交互的真实初始场景，为黑盒驾驶策略的安全评测提供了更有效的场景生成范式。

Abstract: Safety-critical driving scenario generation has largely focused on manipulating the behavior of surrounding agents while starting from an initial scene from driving data. This assumption can limit the space of discoverable failures, since driving data can provide little opportunity for meaningful interaction. For example, in the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, 20.44% of recorded slices feature a stationary ego vehicle that never moves, and 30.39% of initial frames contain no nearby traffic participants within 10 meters. We instead study safety-critical scenario generation as an initialization problem: given agnostic black-box driving policies, we learn to generate realistic initial scenes that are more likely to evolve into critical interactions. We propose AdvScene, a conditional latent diffusion model that is trained in two stages. Starting from pretraining on naturalistic driving data, we post-train the adversarial-agent generation branch using reinforcement learning with feedback from closed-loop simulator rollouts. Conditioning on ego driving displacement prevents the ego from remaining static, and RL finetuning induces criticality directly with non-differentiable safety-critical metrics. Experiments on the Waymo dataset across 12 combinations of ego and traffic policies show that our AdvScene substantially increases the rate of ego-fault collision events and TTC<3s events.

</details>


### [383] [AnyViewDex: View-Invariant Dexterous Manipulation from RGB Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20107)
*Soham Patil,Om Sanjay Gunjal,Sourabh Bhosale,Arhan Chavare,Ramandeep Singh Hora,Spandan Roy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AnyViewDex 提出一种非对称训练范式，将多视角对比对齐与特权3D几何监督结合，把几何知识在仿真阶段编码进视觉表征，从而在零样本部署时仅用未标定单目RGB与本体感知即可实现视角不变的多指灵巧操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多指灵巧操作的运动视觉策略对相机视角变化高度敏感。现有实现视角不变性的方法多依赖显式3D模态（RGB-D或点云），但会带来硬件依赖、标定需求以及真实部署中对传感器噪声的脆弱性。作者希望在不使用测试时显式3D感知的前提下获得视角不变控制。

Method: 提出 AnyViewDex 非对称训练管线：在仿真训练中结合多视角对比对齐与特权3D几何监督，通过回归绝对3D物体坐标作为辅助目标，提供几何锚定信号，缓解全局池化对比嵌入的空间塌缩（spatial collapse）。部署阶段策略以零样本方式仅使用未标定单目RGB与本体感知运行。方法在强化学习与学生-教师蒸馏两种设定下均得到验证。

Result: 在 xArm7 搭配16自由度 LEAP Hand 的硬件评测中，AnyViewDex 在8个未见物体、6个未标定视角下取得76.7%抓取成功率（480次试验；包含所有消融条件共2,400次试验），表明几何锚定的单目策略可在无测试时深度的情况下零样本迁移。

Conclusion: 视角不变控制无需测试时显式3D传感即可实现，关键在于训练阶段利用仿真中的特权几何监督为视觉表征注入几何先验；该方法可支撑单目灵巧操作策略的零样本真实迁移。

Abstract: Visuomotor policies for multi-fingered dexterous manipulation are highly sensitive to camera viewpoint shifts. To achieve view invariance, recent methods increasingly rely on explicit 3D modalities like RGB-D or point clouds, which can introduce hardware dependencies, calibration requirements, and vulnerability to sensor noise during real-world deployment.
