Motivation: 水下环境中的可扩展机器学习受限于缺乏标注的真实训练数据，这类数据采集与整理成本高昂、耗时费力。模拟数据有望弥补这一差距，支撑多种水下感知学习任务，因此需要能够生成高质量合成数据的工具。

Method: 在OceanSim（基于IsaacSim的水下感知模拟器）基础上扩展一套合成数据生成（SDG）流水线，使用户能够生成大规模、自动标注、照片级真实感的数据集，并可配置场景外观、结构与传感器设置。随后以真实世界的海胆检测任务为基准进行实验，研究不同形式的合成场景变化对sim-to-real性能的影响。

Result: 在真实海胆检测任务上验证了该流水线，并分析了不同合成场景变化形式对sim-to-real迁移性能的影响，得出了相关实验发现。

Conclusion: 总结了实验结果与主要发现，指出当前流水线的主要局限，并明确了未来改进方向，包括提升水下渲染保真度、增强场景多样性以及改进sim-to-real泛化能力评估。开源代码已发布于 https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim。

Abstract: Scalable machine learning in challenging underwater environments is strongly limited by the lack of labeled real-world training data. This data is often expensive and laborious to gather, making large-scale real-world data challenging to gather and curate. However, simulated data can help close the gap, enabling many learning-based tasks for underwater perception. In this work, we extend OceanSim, an IsaacSim-based underwater perception simulator, with a Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) pipeline for training models to be used in underwater scenarios. The proposed pipeline enables users to generate large, automatically labeled, photorealistic datasets with configurable scene appearance, structure, and sensor settings. We evaluate the pipeline on a real-world sea urchin detection task and study how different forms of synthetic scene variation affect sim-to-real performance. Based on these experiments, we discuss findings on our results, main limitations of the current pipeline and identify future directions for improving underwater rendering fidelity, scene diversity, and the evaluation of sim-to-real generalization. The open-source code can be found at https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim.

</details>


### [419] [Custom PX4 firmware for autonomous hybrid aerial-marine missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20691)
*Andrea Capuozzo,Fabio Ruggiero,Vincenzo Lippiello*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文为水空两栖无人机提出一种PX4固件扩展，新增手动与自主水面航行模式，并集成到标准PX4任务流程与QGroundControl界面中，在保留原有飞行功能与安全机制的同时支持水空混合任务统一规划，仿真实验验证了平静与波浪水面下的稳定航行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水环境测绘与监测需要同一任务中兼具飞行与水面航行能力的混合型无人机，而现有PX4固件缺少对此类平台的水面导航与混合任务支持。

Method: 对PX4固件进行扩展，实现手动与自主两种海洋（水面）导航模式，并将其接入标准PX4任务管线及QGroundControl地面站界面；通过区分空中航点与水面航点，统一编排水空混合任务，同时保持原有飞行功能与安全机制不变。

Result: 仿真案例研究验证了该实现方案的有效性，并表明平台在平静水面与波浪条件下均能实现稳定的水面航行。

Conclusion: 该框架可在不牺牲原飞行能力的前提下实现水空两栖任务的统一规划与执行，为水环境测绘与监测提供了可行的固件级解决方案。

Abstract: Mapping and monitoring aquatic environments can benefit from hybrid aerial-amphibious drones able to combine flight and water-surface navigation within the same mission. This paper presents a PX4 firmware extension for such platforms, introducing manual and autonomous marine navigation modes integrated with the standard PX4 mission pipeline and QGroundControl interface. The proposed framework preserves existing flight functionalities and safety mechanisms while enabling unified planning and execution of hybrid aerial-marine missions with differentiated aerial and marine waypoints. Simulated case studies validate the implementation and demonstrate stable surface navigation under calm and wavy conditions.

</details>


### [420] [HOPHY: A Hierarchical Hypergraph Representation for Off-Road Path and Mission Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20694)
*Pranay Meshram,Charuvahan Adhivarahan,Prithvi Poddar,Ehsan Tarkesh Esfahani,Chen Wang,Souma Chowdhury,Karthik Dantu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HOPHY——基于超图的可复用分层越野地形表示，将地图尺度地形组织为几何连通的语义区域、保连通性的关键区域以及带类型超边。超边求交可在不重建层次结构的情况下选定受影响区域进行状态更新。在公里级真实越野地图上实现100%规划成功率，成本偏差中位数低于0.01%，查询与重规划延迟显著低于像素与抽象基线；在MRTA任务中计算量较像素A*降低79倍，并在实体Jackal上完成1.5公里八任务混合路面任务及阻塞触发重规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害响应、搜索救援与战术UGV作业要求在地形、智能体类型和目标变化时反复进行路径与任务规划。像素网格搜索对重复的公里级查询代价高昂，而语义抽象必须在地形条件变化时保持有效代价与连通性。

Method: HOPHY是一种可复用分层地形表示：将地图尺度地形组织为几何连通的语义区域（GSNodes）、保连通性的关键区域（Coarse Regions）以及用于表达地形、智能体和天气上下文的带类型超边；利用超边求交选定受影响区域及其关联边以完成状态更新，无需重建层次结构。

Result: 在覆盖公里级范围的真实越野地图上，HOPHY实现100%规划成功率，与oracle（像素A*）相比代价偏差中位数小于0.01%，查询与重规划延迟显著低于所评估的像素基线与抽象基线。应用于多机器人任务分配（MRTA）问题，计算总量较像素A*减少79倍、较最快的抽象基线减少7.2倍，任务总完成时间与像素A*相当。在实体Clearpath Jackal上成功执行了1.5公里、八任务的混合路面户外任务及阻塞触发的重规划路径。

Conclusion: HOPHY通过分层超图表示实现了可复用的越野地形规划，在保证与像素级A*相近解质量的同时大幅降低查询与重规划延迟，并具备向多机器人任务分配与实体平台部署的扩展性。

Abstract: Mission-level autonomy for disaster response, search and rescue, and tactical UGV operations requires repeated path and mission planning as terrain conditions, agent types, and objectives change. Pixel-grid search is costly for repeated kilometer-scale queries, while semantic abstractions must maintain valid costs and connectivity as conditions change. We present HOPHY (Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs), a reusable hierarchical terrain representation that organizes map-scale terrain into geometrically connected semantic regions (GSNodes), connectivity-preserving critical regions (Coarse Regions), and typed hyperedges for terrain, agent, and weather context. Hyperedge intersections select affected regions and incident edges for state updates without rebuilding the hierarchy. Across real off-road maps spanning kilometer-scale areas, HOPHY achieves 100% planning success and less than 0.01% median cost deviation from the oracle (pixel A*), with substantially lower query and replanning latency than the evaluated pixel and abstraction baselines. Applied to a multi-robot task-allocation (MRTA) problem, these gains reduce total computation by 79x over pixel A* and 7.2x over the fastest abstraction baseline, with mission makespan comparable to pixel A*. Finally, we demonstrate HOPHY on a physical Clearpath Jackal that successfully executes a 1.5-km, eight-task mission across mixed-surface outdoor terrain and a blockage-triggered replanned route.

</details>


### [421] [MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20709)
*Jiayu Wang,Bin Zhu,Yue Yu,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MoWAM，用显式未来运动预测替代未来视频生成，兼具高效性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有World Action Models（WAMs）通过引入未来动力学提升机器人策略学习，但推理时显式生成未来视频带来大量计算开销；若移除未来生成虽提升效率，却使未来动力学仅隐式编码于观测特征中，在分布偏移下鲁棒性受限。

Method: MoWAM将未来视频生成替换为显式未来运动预测，把结构化机器人运动建模为未来场景的紧凑抽象，捕捉机器人在当前场景与交互约束下的预期演化。采用Mixture-of-Transformer架构，训练时学习未来视觉动力学并联合预测运动与动作，使推理时可完全去除视频生成，同时保留对未来显式表征。紧凑运动表征还支持推理时扩展：采样多组运动-动作候选，并用运动感知的任务进度验证器进行选择。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus及真实世界操作任务上，MoWAM取得强分布内性能、更优的分布外鲁棒性，以及高于代表性WAM基线的真实世界平均成功率；随候选数量增加性能持续提升。

Conclusion: 显式未来运动预测是兼顾效率与鲁棒性的有效未来表征，可作为推理时扩展的高效基础，优于依赖未来视频生成的WAM范式。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

</details>


### [422] [Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20731)
*Yuheng Zhou,Haiyang Cheng,Yanqi Feng,Pangkit Fong,Mei Xuan Lee,Marcus Gee,Chongrong Fang,Jianping He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向AUV的立体视觉伺服框架，通过目标专用深度提取与卡尔曼滤波获取稳定3D相对状态，并将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，采用自适应模型融合MPC实现实时目标跟踪，仿真与实机实验验证其优于现有框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉水下目标跟踪面临深度测量不可靠与目标运动未知两大挑战，现有框架难以在实时性与鲁棒性之间取得平衡，亟需稳定的相对状态估计与高效的控制结构。

Method: 感知端：利用颜色、视差与时间线索构建目标深度掩码以筛选可靠目标像素，提取目标专用深度，并对深度测量与检测图像中心分别进行卡尔曼滤波，得到稳定3D相对状态。控制端：将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，避免计算昂贵的耦合多自由度优化，从而实现实时平移MPC；平移控制器采用自适应模型融合预测控制，融合恒速与零速目标模型，依据历史预测误差在线更新模型权重，并在执行器、跟随距离与视场约束下求解平移指令。

Result: 通过仿真与真实世界实验验证了框架的有效性，并显示其性能优于现有框架。

Conclusion: 该立体视觉伺服框架以"可靠感知+解耦控制+自适应模型融合"为核心，在保证实时性的同时提升了水下目标跟踪的鲁棒性与精度，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.

</details>


### [423] [MILER: Semantic Mid-Level Representation for Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning in Unstructured Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20747)
*Thomas Steinecker,Denis Trescher,Alexander Bienemann,Thorsten Luettel,Mirko Maehlisch*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MILER，一种端到端策略框架，利用定制语义中层表示（MLR）仿真器离线训练强化学习策略，并在实车上通过BEVFusion生成一致的鸟瞰语义表示，结合轨迹对齐策略实现感知与控制的零样本仿真到现实迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习在自动驾驶中应用稀少，尤其非结构化环境的仿真到现实迁移困难，本文旨在解决该问题，实现零样本迁移。

Method: 离线训练阶段，使用定制语义中层表示（MLR）仿真器，用强化学习训练策略网络，控制输出直接作用于自行车模型；部署阶段，用BEVFusion处理相机与LiDAR生成与MLR仿真器一致的鸟瞰语义表示，策略网络动作不直接作用于实车，而是采用轨迹对齐策略实现感知与控制的零样本迁移。

Result: 在包含多种障碍、发卡弯、最高33.6 km/h速度及越野路段的测试赛道评估，两辆不同车辆在3.0 km测试赛道共行驶17.3 km无人工干预；整个软件栈在Jetson AGX Orin上运行。

Conclusion: MILER有效实现了非结构化环境下感知与控制零样本仿真到现实的端到端自动驾驶，验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning constitutes a promising approach owing to its potential for superhuman performance and self-learned policies. However, its application to real-world autonomous driving remains scarce, particularly in unstructured environments, because of the challenges associated with sim-to-real transfer for unstructured environments. In this work, we present MILER, an end-to-end policy framework with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. During offline training, we employ a custom semantic mid-level representation (MLR) simulator and train the policy network using reinforcement learning, with its control outputs applied directly to a bicycle model. During deployment on the real vehicle, camera and LiDAR data are processed by BEVFusion to generate a semantic bird's-eye-view representation consistent with that of the MLR simulator. The actions generated by the policy network are not applied directly to the real vehicle. Instead, we employ a trajectory-alignment strategy that enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of both perception and control. We extensively evaluate the proposed framework on a diverse test track comprising numerous challenges, including various obstacles, hairpin curves, velocities of up to 33.6 km/h, and off-road sections. In total, we drove 17.3 km with two different vehicles on a 3.0 km test track without human intervention, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, the entire software stack runs on a Jetson AGX Orin.

</details>


### [424] [OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20756)
*Damiano Da Col,Maximilian Igl,Peter Karkus,Kashyap Chitta,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Konrad Schindler,Christos Sakaridis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出OPTED，通过解耦强化学习与端到端策略的后训练：先用RL在向量化输入（HD地图、边界框）上训练特权教师，再由其在闭环后训练中监督预训练的学生模型，从而以极少仿真交互提升驾驶性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠扩大预训练数据规模收益递减，后训练在自动驾驶等物理AI领域愈发重要。端到端驾驶策略通过行为克隆在人类演示上以开环方式预训练，但闭环部署中的误差累积会将车辆带出训练数据分布，增加安全关键事故风险。闭环后训练虽可缓解该问题，却需针对基于传感器的策略进行昂贵仿真。

Method: 提出OPTED（on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving），将强化学习与端到端策略的后训练解耦：先以RL在向量化输入（HD地图与边界框）上训练特权教师；该教师在闭环后训练中向预训练学生提供监督。将OPTED应用于两种相机模型TransFuser与VaVAM，在AlpaSim中利用真实驾驶日志的神经重建（3DGS）进行微调。

Result: 驾驶分数分别提升1.6倍与9.5倍。在受控实验中，OPTED以比直接RL后训练少约三个数量级的仿真器交互，达到相当的闭环性能，同时更贴近人类先验。

Conclusion: OPTED证明可通过特权教师解耦RL与学生后训练，在显著降低仿真成本的同时有效提升端到端驾驶策略的闭环性能，并保持与人类行为先验的接近。

Abstract: As scaling pre-training data alone yields diminishing returns, post-training is becoming increasingly important across physical AI domains such as autonomous driving. End-to-end driving policies are pre-trained in open loop with behavior cloning on human demonstrations. However, compounding errors during closed-loop deployment can take the vehicle outside the training data distribution, increasing the risk of safety-critical incidents. Closed-loop post-training can mitigate this risk but requires costly simulation for sensor-based policies. We propose OPTED (on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving) which decouples reinforcement learning from the post-training of the end-to-end policy: a privileged teacher is trained using RL on vectorized inputs (HD-map and bounding boxes). This teacher then provides supervision to the pre-trained student during closed-loop post-training. We apply OPTED to two camera-based models, TransFuser and VaVAM, and fine-tune them in AlpaSim, using neural reconstructions (3DGS) of real driving logs. Driving scores increase by factors of 1.6$\times$ and 9.5$\times$, respectively. In controlled experiments OPTED matches closed-loop performance with approximately three orders of magnitude fewer simulator interactions than direct RL post-training, while staying closer to the human prior. Project page: https://01dami23.github.io/opted/

</details>


### [425] [Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20761)
*Hanchu Zhou,Brendan Lynch,Raman Goyal,Dechen Gao,Begum Kasap,Boqi Zhao,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出敏捷触觉世界动作模型TARO，通过共享潜空间流匹配与多时间尺度多模态预测，实现高效高精度的接触丰富操作控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型依赖大规模预训练生成骨干网络捕捉接触物理动力学，导致推理效率低、部署不灵活，难以满足高频精确控制需求。

Method: 将视觉与触觉观测编码到共享潜在空间，作为直接视觉-触觉到动作的流匹配过程源，联合生成动作块与未来视觉/触觉潜表示；并引入多时间跨度多模态预测：视觉潜表示用较大时间偏移监督，触觉潜表示预测下一帧以捕捉细粒度接触动态。

Result: 在九个仿真和五个真实接触丰富操作任务中表现强且鲁棒，成功率超过最强基线；五个真实实验中总体成功率相对提升29.4%，推理延迟仅11.9 ms。

Conclusion: 多模态世界动作模型可通过敏捷架构实现，适用于精确高频机器人控制。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$. These results demonstrate that multimodal WAM can be achieved with an agile architecture suitable for precise and high-frequency robot control. More details are available on our project page: https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/.

</details>


### [426] [GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20776)
*Xin Chen,Sen Chen,Yujuan Ding,Jian Liu,Guoqing Wang,Wei Ye,Heng Tao Shen,Yi Bin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出GeoAAC，一种基于几何的自适应动作分块方法，根据Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何信息动态调整VLA策略的动作视界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA策略多采用固定动作视界，但任务不同阶段对动作连续性、控制精度和闭环反馈需求不同，固定视界难以适应变化的控制要求。

Method: 发现Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何特性可提供过程级信息来刻画预测可靠性，且动作前缀间的几何变化与预测不确定性正相关。GeoAAC利用前缀几何构建视界级几何轮廓，在单次生成中自适应确定动作视界，无需额外训练。

Result: 在GR00T N1.5和π0.5上、于LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365及真实操作任务中，一致优于固定视界基线和现有自适应方法，仿真提升最高达8.7个百分点，真实平均成功率从53.3%提升至74.4%。

Conclusion: GeoAAC证明了去噪轨迹几何可作为预测可靠性的有效判据，实现免训练、单次生成的自适应动作分块，显著提升VLA策略性能。

Abstract: Action chunking is widely used for action generation and execution in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, yet existing approaches commonly use a fixed action horizon. During a rollout, different task stages may require different levels of action continuity, control precision, and closed-loop feedback, making a fixed horizon unable to accommodate changing control requirements. We propose \textbf{GeoAAC}, a geometry-based adaptive action chunking method for flow-based VLA policies that adjusts the action horizon according to the reliability of the current action prediction. We show that the geometry of Flow Matching denoising trajectories provides process-level information for characterizing prediction reliability, with geometric variation across action prefixes remaining positively correlated with predictive uncertainty. GeoAAC uses this prefix-wise geometry to construct a horizon-wise geometric profile and adaptively determine the action horizon from a single generation without additional training. Experiments with GR00T N1.5 and π0.5 on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation tasks show consistent improvements over fixed-action-horizon baselines and existing adaptive methods, including up to 8.7 percentage points in simulation and an increase in average real-world success rate from 53.3\% to 74.4\%.

</details>


### [427] [StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20791)
*Jinbang Huang,Yuanzhao Hu,Zhiyuan Li,Ran Qi,Yixin Xiao,Yangzheng Wu,Tengyue Ba,Zhanguang Zhang,Yingxue Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出StageGuard，一种智能体蒸馏框架，用于分层规划中准确高效的阶段过渡决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层规划框架需要判断何时终止当前技能并进入下一子任务，但现有方法依赖难以获得的预设计完成信号检查器；而大型视觉语言模型（VLM）虽具推理能力，其决策边界与任务完成标准不一致，且云端部署与冗长推理带来高延迟，限制实时监控。

Method: StageGuard通过教师模型推理与示范轨迹结合，生成子任务完成和政策切换的结构化解释；轻量级学生VLM利用这些解释生成紧凑的自我解释，并用于监督微调。

Result: 在两个基准的轨迹上评估阶段过渡预测，并通过集成到分层机器人控制在BEHAVIOR-1K上评估闭环任务成功率，并在真实机器人上进一步验证。结果显示阶段过渡预测显著提升，同时支持高效在线监控。

Conclusion: StageGuard能实现准确且高效的阶段过渡决策，提升阶段过渡预测性能，并支持高效的在线监控。

Abstract: Hierarchical planning frameworks combine skills from multiple robot control policies for long-horizon task execution, where determining when to terminate the current skill and advance to the next subtask is essential. Existing approaches often rely on pre-designed completion signal checkers that are hard to obtain in real-world execution. Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, but their decision boundaries are not inherently aligned with task completion criteria, while cloud deployment and lengthy reasoning introduce substantial latency, limiting real-time monitoring. We propose StageGuard, an agentic distillation framework for accurate and efficient stage-transition decisions. StageGuard combines teacher-model reasoning with demonstration trajectories to generate structured explanations of subtask completion and policy switching. A lightweight student VLM uses these explanations to generate compact self-explanations, which are used for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate stage-transition prediction on trajectories from two benchmarks and assess closed-loop task success through integration into hierarchical robot control on BEHAVIOR-1K, with further validation on real robots. Results show substantial improvements in stage-transition prediction while supporting efficient online monitoring.

</details>


### [428] [Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20820)
*Nitish Dashora,Douglas Chen,Idan Shenfeld,John Marangola,Pulkit Agrawal,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"workspace token"轻量隐式记忆表示，在训练时用VLM蒸馏出任务相关的历史信息，部署时无需在线VLM查询即可让策略求解长时序记忆任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时序机器人操作任务需要历史记忆，但直接条件化于完整历史会引入虚假相关并降低性能；现有方法依赖在部署循环中进行昂贵的VLM查询来压缩历史信息，计算开销大。

Method: 将计算密集的VLM查询移至训练阶段：先用VLM识别完成任务所需的当前与历史信息，再通过集合重建解码器损失（set-reconstruction decoder loss）将这些信息蒸馏进workspace token这一轻量隐记忆表示，部署时可直接替代观测进行查询。

Result: 在仿真和真实硬件上，workspace token 可作为部署时观测的即插即用替代，使策略无需在线VLM推理即可求解记忆密集型任务；且不仅更轻量，还带来更好的策略性能。

Conclusion: 通过在训练时蒸馏VLM知识为轻量隐记忆，可在部署时摆脱昂贵的在线VLM查询，同时提升策略效率与性能，为长时序记忆型机器人操作提供了新范式。

Abstract: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop. Interestingly, we found that workspace tokens are not only more lightweight but also lead to better policy performance.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [429] [SiliconBench: Speed, Memory, and Fidelity for LLM Serving on Unified-Memory Desktops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19169)
*Ranran Haoran Zhang,Aysa Xuemo Fan,David Munhá Correia,Alex Cheema,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 SiliconBench 基准，从速度、内存、保真度三个维度评估九种 Apple Silicon 本地 LLM 服务引擎，并给出架构就绪度、内存纪律与多节点扩展三方面的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在统一内存桌面上并发运行本地 LLM 时，必须同时保证内存余量（headroom）与输出保真度，而仅以速度排名的评测方式忽略了这些关键因素，因此需要构建兼顾速度、内存与保真度的综合评测基准。

Method: 提出 SiliconBench，从速度、内存、保真度三个视角评估九种 Apple Silicon 服务引擎；在 Qwen3、Qwen3.5 和 Gemma 4 上进行聊天与智能体（agent）服务评测；用分类任务对照 NVIDIA 参考实现检查质量退化，并以 DGX Spark 作为补充性能参照；通过三项判据（服务架构就绪度、内存纪律、多节点扩展）解读结果；在测试的双机配置中比较 Thunderbolt RDMA 张量并行与 TCP 流水线并行。

Result: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 上，vllm-metal 在并发从 1 增至 16 时两种工作负载吞吐均翻倍以上；CUDA 上的 vLLM 与 SGLang 在相同提示下呈现更强的并发扩展性；显式内存预算并不保证内存余量——两个栈虽完成全部请求，但内存占用逼近物理上限且吞吐下降；新模型架构的引擎支持更窄，但所评估的实现均与保真度参考一致；仅三个栈通过完成度、保真度与模型覆盖的门槛。较大稠密与 MoE 模型上的比较表明，调度提示处理与持续生成协同至关重要：vllm-metal 的打包 prefill-decode 路径在并发负载下首 token 延迟低于 omlx。双机配置中，Thunderbolt RDMA 上的张量并行可扩展，而 TCP 上的流水线并行出现退化。

Conclusion: 并发本地服务评测必须同时考察内存余量与输出保真度，而非仅看速度；引擎对新架构的支持、显式内存预算的有效性以及并行策略的选择均显著影响实际可用性；作者发布基准代码、逐次运行结果与维护日志，并辅以“有界智能体修复 + 人工复核”的工作流。

Abstract: Concurrent local LLM serving on unified-memory desktops must preserve memory headroom and output fidelity, which speed-only rankings overlook. We introduce SiliconBench, which evaluates nine Apple Silicon serving engines through three lenses: speed, memory, and fidelity. We evaluate chat and agent serving on Qwen3, Qwen3.5, and Gemma 4. We use a classification task to check for quality regressions against an NVIDIA reference. DGX Spark provides a complementary serving-performance reference. Three desiderata guide interpretation: serving architecture readiness, memory discipline, and multi-node scaling. On Qwen3-0.6B, vllm-metal alone more than doubles throughput on both workloads from concurrency 1 to 16. CUDA vLLM and SGLang show stronger concurrency scaling on the same prompts. Explicit memory budgets do not guarantee memory headroom: two stacks complete every request while memory use approaches physical capacity and throughput declines. The newer model architectures have narrower engine support. Their evaluated implementations match the fidelity reference. Only three stacks satisfy the completion, fidelity, and model-coverage gates. Comparisons on larger dense and MoE models reinforce the importance of scheduling prompt processing alongside ongoing generation: vllm-metal's packed prefill-decode path maintains lower first-token latency than omlx under concurrent load. In the tested two-machine configurations, tensor parallelism over Thunderbolt RDMA scales while pipeline parallelism over TCP regresses. We release benchmark code, per-run results, and maintenance journals, supported by a workflow combining bounded agent fixes with human review.

</details>


### [430] [CovR: Coverage-Aware Hardware Verification via Reasoning-Guided Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19189)
*Manar Abdelatty,Maryam Nouh,Sherief Reda*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: CovR：面向覆盖率驱动的LLM测试平台生成智能体框架，通过自反思+仿真反馈构建数据集并做RL微调，显著提升覆盖率与验证工作流效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计验证占硬件开发工作量高达约70%，资源消耗巨大。现有基于LLM的testbench生成工作多聚焦功能正确性，忽视了覆盖率质量这一关键指标，导致生成的激励难以充分触发设计状态空间。

Method: 提出智能体框架CovR：将自反思循环与基于仿真的反馈结合，用于自动化testbench生成以最大化覆盖率；用强教师模型构建16,514条“自然语言规格—RTL推理—testbench”元组数据集，实现覆盖率感知监督；进一步提出面向覆盖率驱动testbench生成的强化学习框架，利用仿真与覆盖率反馈的工具化奖励优化学生模型；并将微调模型回灌到智能体精炼管线，且可作为插件式激励引擎接入完整验证流程。

Result: 微调模型在VerilogEval与RTLLM V2.0上cov@10达93.81%，在CVDP上达87.76%，分别超越SOTA 7.97%与3.59%；回灌智能体精炼管线后进一步提升至94.27%（VerilogEval/RTLLM V2.0）与91.39%（CVDP）；作为插件式激励引擎接入完整验证流程时，覆盖率提升18.95%，变异检测分数提升1.19%，并揭示4.46%未被检测到的失效。

Conclusion: 在LLM硬件验证中显式优化覆盖率至关重要；CovR通过覆盖率感知的数据构建、RL奖励设计与智能体精炼，能同时提升覆盖率与验证有效性，验证了覆盖率驱动范式在自动testbench生成中的价值。

Abstract: Design verification remains one of the most resource-intensive stages of hardware development, often consuming up to 70% of the total design effort. While recent work has explored using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate testbench generation, most existing approaches focus narrowly on functional correctness, overlooking the critical aspect of coverage quality. To bridge this gap, we present CovR, an agentic framework for automated testbench generation that combines self-reflection loops with simulation-based feedback to maximize coverage. Using this pipeline, we construct a large-scale dataset of 16,514 natural specification RTL reasoning testbench tuples with a strong teacher model, enabling coverage-aware supervision. Building on this, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored for coverage-driven testbench generation, leveraging tool-derived rewards from simulation and coverage feedback to optimize a student model. Experimental results show that the CovR finetuned model achieves 93.81% cov@10 on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0, and 87.76% cov@10 on CVDP, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches by 7.97% and 3.59%, respectively. Furthermore, deploying the finetuned model back into the agentic refinement pipeline further improves cov@10 to 94.27% on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0 and 91.39% on CVDP. Moreover, when integrated as a plug-in stimulus engine for full verification workflows, CovR improves coverage by 18.95% and mutation detection score by 1.19%, while revealing 4.46% undetected failures, highlighting the importance of optimizing for coverage in LLM-based hardware verification.

</details>


### [431] [Epic: Efficient Programming Paradigm for In-Storage Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19206)
*Yuyue Wang,Zhenyu Zhang,Glenn Reinman,Huaicheng Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 Epic，一种基于 NVMe 的存内计算（ISC）栈，通过位置类型、数据流与 keep 原语统一抽象数据驻留与生命周期，配合存储感知编译器与运行时，在 12 个负载上平均比最强前置 ISC 系统快 1.6 倍，相对主机基线平均加速 4.2 倍、最高 16.1 倍，并最多减少 14 倍应用侧代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 存内计算（ISC）通过在计算存储设备（CSD）内部执行计算来减少主机—存储间的数据搬运，但面向多阶段应用时，需要协同数据放置、I/O—计算重叠与设备驻留状态；现有接口缺乏统一抽象来支撑这些决策。

Method: Epic 提供统一抽象：location types 声明逻辑驻留位置，dataflow 在单次调用内推导中间值与操作状态的生命周期，keep 原语将选定状态跨调用延续，从而把整个卸载工作流表达为带位置的有状态数据流。配套存储感知编译器执行搬移感知的逻辑映射与融合，并暴露 I/O—计算重叠；运行时利用执行期信息完成计划，异步地把工作绑定到物理资源并管理设备驻留状态。

Result: 在 12 个文件扫描、数据库与机器学习负载上，Epic 平均比五种前置 ISC 系统中最强的一个快 1.6 倍；相对对应主机基线平均加速 4.2 倍、最高 16.1 倍；在实现中最多将应用侧代码减少 14 倍。

Conclusion: 通过将卸载工作流统一抽象为带位置、有状态的数据流，并借助存储感知编译与运行时协同，Epic 有效释放了多阶段 ISC 应用的性能收益，同时显著降低编程复杂度。

Abstract: In-storage computing (ISC) reduces host--storage data movement by executing computation inside computational storage devices (CSDs). For multi-stage applications, realizing these benefits requires coordinating data placement, I/O--compute overlap, and device-resident state across the workflow, yet existing interfaces lack a unified abstraction for these decisions. We present Epic, an NVMe-based ISC stack that provides this abstraction by capturing data residency and lifetime in the program: location types declare logical residency, dataflow derives lifetimes for intermediate values and operation state within an invocation, and a keep primitive extends selected state across invocations. These semantics expose the complete offloaded workflow as a located, stateful dataflow. A storage-aware compiler transforms this workflow, performs movement-aware logical mapping and fusion, and exposes I/O--compute overlap; a runtime completes the plan using execution-time information, asynchronously binding work to physical resources and managing device-resident state. Across 12 file-scanning, database, and machine learning workloads, Epic is 1.6$\times$ faster on average than the strongest of five prior ISC systems, while achieving 4.2$\times$ speedup on average and up to 16.1$\times$ over the corresponding host baselines, and reducing application-side code by up to 14$\times$ in our implementations.

</details>


### [432] [MeshKV: A Network-on-Chip KV Cache Fabric for Scalable Transformer Decoding Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19207)
*Dong Liu,Yanxuan Yu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MeshKV：面向分块加速器的KV缓存fabric，通过NoC分组化传输与TaKV/Mare/Pad协同设计，缓解长上下文服务中的互连瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归Transformer解码受限于分块加速器上KV缓存的不规则搬运；已有压缩与DRAM放置方案仍将流量集中于中心化存储路径，成为长上下文服务的瓶颈。

Method: 提出MeshKV——以轻量NoC将KV块作为分组化流传输的KV缓存fabric，协同设计三项技术：(i) TaKV仿射条带化，分散home节点、降低热点负载；(ii) Mare组播，带可验证的重复抑制；(iii) Pad，在credit对齐FIFO后重叠预取、tile乘与streaming softmax。

Result: 在8x8 FPGA上以LLaMA-2-7B和Mistral-7B、8K–32K上下文评测：互连流量最多降低58%，KV带宽利用率提升2.1倍，多流吞吐最高提升1.9倍。

Conclusion: 该设计将二分带宽背压转化为有效的KV传输，验证了NoC化KV fabric在长上下文推理服务中的有效性。

Abstract: Autoregressive transformer decoding is constrained by irregular key-value (KV) cache movement on tiled accelerators. Prior compression and DRAM-placement systems still concentrate traffic on centralized memory paths that bottleneck long-context serving. We present MeshKV, a KV cache fabric that moves blocks as packetized flows over a lightweight NoC. It co-designs (i) TaKV affine striping to spread homes and cut hotspot load, (ii) Mare multicast with verified duplicate suppression, and (iii) Pad, which overlaps prefetch, tile multiply, and streaming softmax behind credit-aligned FIFOs. Together they convert bisection back-pressure into useful KV transfer. On our 8x8 FPGA implementation with LLaMA-2-7B and Mistral-7B at 8K-32K, MeshKV reduces interconnect traffic by up to 58%, improves KV bandwidth utilization by 2.1x, and delivers up to 1.9x multi-stream throughput.

</details>


### [433] [MiX: Micro-Inverted-Scaling for End-to-End Low-Bit Vision-Language Model Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19683)
*Yuan Liao,Jae-sun Seo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Micro-Inverted-Scaling（MiX）量化格式及配套自适应双格式推理框架（MiX-MX），用于边缘设备上的视觉语言模型部署，实现 4.5-bit 高精度与高能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在边缘设备部署受内存带宽瓶颈限制，需激进的亚 8-bit 量化，但边缘加速器受面积与功耗约束要求端到端量化模型；多模态 token 间极端动态范围差异使标准 block 格式出现"微缩放崩溃"，单个离群值劫持共享指数导致周围元素下溢并破坏注意力图。

Method: 提出 Micro-Inverted-Scaling（MiX）格式，数学上反转微缩放范式：不再将多个尾数归入单一共享指数，而是将私有的逐元素指数归入单一共享尾数；并引入自适应双格式（MiX-MX）推理框架以应对非对称的 VLM 离群拓扑，通过代数提取共享 MiX 尾数将计算映射到定制加速器，用移位器替代乘法器。

Result: 在多个 VLM 上端到端评测，4.5-bit MiX 在多模态基准上精度等同或优于 NVFP4；MiX 加速器相比 NVFP4 基线面积效率提升 25%，相比 SOTA 加速器 Focus 实现 2.3-4.5 倍加速与 1.4-2.9 倍能耗降低。

Conclusion: 反转缩放数据通路在物理上更适合高效 VLM 部署，MiX 格式与加速器协同设计可突破边缘 VLM 部署的内存带宽瓶颈。

Abstract: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on edge devices is severely bottlenecked by memory bandwidth, necessitating aggressive sub-8-bit quantization. Since edge accelerators are strictly constrained by area and power, they require end-to-end quantized models. However, the extreme dynamic range gap between multi-modal tokens causes standard block formats to suffer "microscaling collapse," where a single massive outlier hijacks the shared exponent, underflowing surrounding elements and destroying attention maps. To break this bottleneck, we propose Micro-Inverted-Scaling (MiX), a novel format that mathematically inverts the microscaling paradigm: rather than grouping multiple mantissas under one shared exponent, MiX groups private, per-element exponents under a single shared mantissa. To handle asymmetric VLM outlier topologies, we introduce an adaptive dual-format (MiX-MX) inference framework. By algebraically factoring out the shared MiX mantissa, this framework maps to a custom accelerator, replacing multipliers with efficient shifters. Evaluated end-to-end on multiple VLMs, our 4.5-bit MiX formulation exhibits equivalent or superior accuracy on multi-modal benchmarks compared to NVFP4. Simultaneously, the MiX accelerator delivers a 25% improvement in area efficiency over the NVFP4 baseline and a 2.3-4.5x speedup with 1.4-2.9x energy reduction across models compared to the state-of-the-art accelerator Focus, proving the inverted-scaling datapath is physically superior for efficient VLM deployment.

</details>


### [434] [High-frequency Multispeculative Multiply-Accumulation Unit for Fused Posit Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19859)
*Mario Alonso,Miguel Ángel Sacristán,Guillermo Botella,Alberto A. Del Barrio*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种优化的高频Multispeculative PositMAC架构，支持32/64位Posit，通过流水线重组、Booth-4+Kogge-Stone乘法器以及用Multispeculative Adder替代大规模quire累加器，在面积、能耗和频率上取得显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Posit算术相比IEEE 754浮点标准具有更高精度，其FMA通过quire宽定点累加器避免中间舍入，实现精确数值可复现性并防止长累加中的精度损失与溢出；但集成如此大的累加器会带来显著的面积和功耗开销，因此需要优化架构以降低开销并提升频率。

Method: 1) 重构流水线以平衡不同阶段；2) 评估高速乘法拓扑，采用Booth-4方案配合Kogge-Stone加法器，满足0.5ns（2GHz）目标；3) 用Multispeculative Adder替代宽单体quire累加器。

Result: 相比基线，面积最多减少19.8%，能耗降低超过50%；与其他先进设计相比，实现最高工作频率，相较64位quire方案循环时间最多减少79.0%；且面积更小、每周期能耗更低，未增加资源开销。

Conclusion: 该Multispeculative PositMAC架构在支持32/64位Posit的同时，有效缓解了quire累加器的面积与功耗问题，实现了更高工作频率、更低循环时间与能耗，并在面积和能效上优于所有具备quire能力的对比方案。

Abstract: Posit arithmetic offers a compelling alternative to the IEEE 754 floating-point standard, providing enhanced accuracy. Its fused multiply-accumulate operations avoid intermediate rounding, ensuring exact numerical reproducibility through the quire, a wide fixed-point accumulator spanning the format's full dynamic range to prevent precision loss and overflow during long accumulations. However, integrating such large accumulators incurs significant area and power overheads. This paper presents an optimized, high-frequency Multispeculative PositMAC architecture for 32- and 64-bits Posit. First, the pipeline is restructured to balance the different stages. Second, high-speed multiplication topologies are evaluated, showing that a Booth-4 scheme with Kogge-Stone adders meets a stringent 0.5ns target (2Ghz). Finally, the wide monolithic quire accumulator is replaced with a Multispeculative Adder, diminishing area up to 19.8\% while reducing energy consumption by more than 50\% when compared to the baseline. Compared to other state-of-the-art designs, our proposal achieves the highest operating frequency and reduces cycle time by up to 79.0\% with respect to 64-bit quire-enabled alternatives. This performance is attained without increasing resource overhead, as the design remains strictly smaller in area and achieves lower per-cycle energy consumption than all quire-capable counterparts.

</details>


### [435] [Evaluation of Power-Clock Waveforms for Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic in 16 nm FinFET Technology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19998)
*Maciej Szymon Pyrzowski,Franciszek Łukowski,Aida Todri-Sanial*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文研究TSMC 16 nm FinFET工艺下的正反馈绝热逻辑（PFAL），构建完整门库并基于能量-延迟积优化电源时钟参数，发现三角波形最优；优化后单元能耗比静态CMOS低至3.83倍，4位Brent-Kung超前进位加法器能耗增益达5.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝热逻辑可通过准可逆开关回收负载电容能量，但FinFET工艺下及多GHz频率下的波形优化运行仍研究不足，因此需要系统表征PFAL在先进工艺与高频下的能耗表现。

Method: 在TSMC 16 nm FinFET工艺中设计并验证功能完备的PFAL门库；以能量-延迟积（EDP）为目标，对电源时钟幅度、频率与波形形状进行优化扫描；进而构建2:1多路复用器、4位行波进位加法器及4位Brent-Kung超前进位加法器等组合电路。

Result: 最小能耗波形接近三角形而非传统梯形；优化后单门PFAL能耗比等效静态CMOS低至3.83倍；正弦激励较梯形激励能耗改善至1.32倍并扩展有效工作范围；三角电源时钟下超前进位加法器能耗增益达5.3倍。

Conclusion: PFAL在16 nm FinFET与多GHz条件下具备显著能耗优势，且电源时钟波形（近三角/正弦）是影响绝热节能效果的关键设计变量，适用于构建低功耗组合逻辑电路。

Abstract: Adiabatic logic can recover part of the energy stored on load capacitances through quasi-reversible switching, but its waveform-optimized operation in FinFET technology and at multi-GHz frequencies remains underexplored. This work investigates Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic (PFAL) in the TSMC 16 nm FinFET process. A functionally complete PFAL gate library is designed, verified, and characterised using energy-delay product optimization over power-clock amplitude, frequency, and waveform shape. The power-clock sweep shows that the minimum-energy waveform approaches a triangular shape rather than a conventional trapezoid. The optimized single-gate PFAL cells achieve up to 3.83x lower energy than equivalent static CMOS gates, while sinusoidal excitation improves energy by up to 1.32x compared with trapezoidal excitation and extends the valid operating range. The library is then used to construct larger combinational circuits, including a 2:1 multiplexer, a 4-bit ripple carry adder, and a 4-bit Brent-Kung carry look-ahead adder. The carry look-ahead adder reaches a gain of up to 5.3x compared with the static CMOS energy estimate for the triangular power-clock.

</details>


### [436] [Evaluating Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic in 16nm FinFET with a Realistic Power-Clock](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19999)
*Franciszek Łukowski,Maciej Pyrzowski,Aida Todri-Sanial*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文在TSMC 16nm FinFET工艺下系统评估了正反馈绝热逻辑(PFAL)，构建标准单元与2×2乘法器、4位比较器，识别三类非绝热损耗并给出EDP与能量优势，配合四相电源时钟VCO验证其低功耗可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝热逻辑通过准可逆开关复用负载电容能量，理论上最低能耗低于静态CMOS，但其在FinFET工艺和多GHz时钟频率下的实用性尚不明确，缺乏系统性评估，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在TSMC 16nm FinFET工艺中对PFAL进行仿真：设计一组PFAL标准单元门以及2×2乘法器和4位比较器两类组合电路，与静态CMOS对比，采用能量延迟积(EDP)和能量优势指标η=E_CMOS/E_PFAL；进行瞬态仿真分析非绝热损耗来源；设计并联耦合正交压控振荡器作为四相电源时钟发生器，并研究非理想供电与扇出加载效应。

Result: 识别出三类非绝热损耗：PMOS/NMOS锁存相关的阈值电压损耗、先前未报道的输出节点冗余充电损耗，以及PFAL逻辑树复杂度引起的损耗。低阈值Buffer/NOT单元在V_CLK=0.6V、f_CLK=7.94GHz时最小EDP为1.23×10^-26 J·s；在较低频率和较高电源电压下PFAL相对静态CMOS保持最高约5倍的能量优势。使用非理想四相电源时钟时，3GHz下Buffer/NOT能耗与理想正弦情况相差在2%以内；加载研究量化了扇出增加引起的相移与幅度衰减。

Conclusion: 本文为16nm FinFET中PFAL提供了面向设计的评估，并为未来低功耗系统架构利用绝热逻辑提供了依据。

Abstract: Adiabatic logic reuses the energy stored on load capacitances through quasi-reversible switching, enabling a lower minimum energy consumption than conventional static CMOS. Yet its practicality in FinFET technologies and at multi-GHz clock rates has yet to be investigated. This work provides a systematic evaluation of Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic (PFAL) simulated in the TSMC 16nm FinFET process. A set of PFAL standard-cell gates were realised, along with two representative combinational circuits - a 2$\times$2 multiplier and a 4-bit comparator - and compared against static CMOS logic using the energy--delay product (EDP) and the energy advantage metric $η= E_{\mathrm{CMOS}} / E_{\mathrm{PFAL}}$. Transient simulations reveal three sources of non-adiabatic loss: two specific to the PMOS/NMOS latch, threshold-voltage-related loss and a previously unreported redundant charging of the output node and one related to the complexity of PFAL logic trees. The low-threshold Buffer/NOT cell achieves a minimum EDP of $1.23\times10^{-26}$J$\cdot$s at $V_{\mathrm{CLK}} = 0.6$V and $f_{\mathrm{CLK}} = 7.94$GHz, while PFAL preserves an energy benefit over static CMOS of up to roughly $5\times$ at reduced frequencies and elevated supply voltages. A parallel-coupled quadrature voltage-controlled oscillator is designed as a realistic four-phase power-clock generator. With this non-ideal supply, the Buffer/NOT energy stays within $2\%$ of the ideal sinusoidal case at $3$GHz. A loading study quantifies the phase shift and amplitude reduction induced by increasing fan-out. Overall, the results provide a design-oriented evaluation of PFAL in 16nm FinFET and a motivation to exploit adiabatic logic for future low-power system architectures.

</details>


### [437] [Spectral Signatures for Parametric Fault Detection in Flexible Electronics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20315)
*Paula Carolina Lozano Duarte,Sule Ozev,Mehdi Tahoori*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于VCO频谱能量的频域测试签名电路，用于IGZO柔性单极性TFT的AMS电路故障与参数偏差检测，具备面积小、功耗低、无需精密基准与ATE的特点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IGZO柔性电子用于可穿戴与生物监测，其模拟混合信号模块面临器件变异大、无刚性封装易失效、参数故障无硬性数字失效、专用ATE昂贵且难以现场使用等测试难题；传统基于ADC的测试方案面积开销大，且ADC精度本身受PVT影响，会导致测试失效。

Method: 利用压控振荡器（VCO）将故障引起的控制电压偏差转换为频率偏移，经轻量级模拟滤波器处理；以谐波分量的RMS值作为紧凑测试签名，该签名对工作点偏差具有单调灵敏度并在PVT角下保持序关系；引入比例式（ratiometric）精炼以抑制温度与电源引起的后校准漂移；签名通过两个I/O引脚读出。

Result: 签名无需精密参考或匹配比较器即可稳健工作；比例式精炼将温度与电源变化导致的后校准漂移抑制达一个数量级；电路面积6390 μm²、功耗16.7 μW，相比紧凑型ADC面积缩减26倍，相比SAR实现缩减近1500倍；支持无ATE的现场测试。

Conclusion: 该频域测试签名电路为资源受限的IGZO柔性AMS系统提供了一种低面积、低功耗、可现场部署的故障与参数偏差检测方案，克服了ADC方案的面积与PVT稳健性瓶颈。

Abstract: Flexible electronics (FE) based on indium gallium zinc oxide (IGZO) unipolar thin-film transistor (TFT) technologies enable lightweight, conformable systems for wearable sensing, biomedical monitoring, and human-machine interfaces. These applications rely on analog and mixed-signal (AMS) blocks that must remain accurate despite key challenges: increased device variability from low-cost unipolar fabrication; susceptibility to post-manufacturing failures due to the absence of rigid packaging; parametric faults that degrade analog accuracy without hard digital failures; and the high cost and in-field inaccessibility of specialized Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) for disposable FE systems. Conventional test approaches relying on analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) incur prohibitive area overhead in resource-constrained systems; critically, ADC accuracy is itself subject to process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations, leading to test invalidations. This work proposes a frequency-domain test signature circuit exploiting spectral energy from a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) to detect faults and parametric deviations in AMS circuits under test. The VCO converts fault-induced control-voltage deviations into frequency shifts processed through lightweight analog filters. RMS values of harmonic components serve as compact signatures with monotonic sensitivity to operating-point deviations while preserving ordering across PVT corners, ensuring robust operation without precision references or matched comparators. A ratiometric refinement suppresses post-calibration drift from temperature and supply variation by up to an order of magnitude. The signature is readable via two I/O pins, enabling in-field test without ATE. The circuit occupies 6390 $μ$m$^2$ and consumes 16.7 $μ$W, achieving 26$\times$ area reduction versus compact ADCs and nearly 1500$\times$ versus SAR implementations.

</details>

### [438] [Large Language Model Agents for Evidence Based Genetic Disease Severity Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19569)
*Tohid Ghasemnejad,Ahmadreza Argha,Mark Grosser,John Wang,Min Yang,Thantrira Porntaveetus,Tony Roscioli,Nigel H. Lovell,Mahmoud Aarabi,Hamid Alinejad-Rokny*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个结合ReAct与RAG的自主AI智能体，用于对10,211个HPO术语进行疾病严重程度自动化分类，表型层面准确率达93.55%，并在基因层面和外部验证中表现出高度可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗传病严重程度分类具有主观性和劳动密集性，导致基因组筛查存在瓶颈，且商业检测panel在规模和重叠范围上差异较大，亟需标准化的自动化分类方法。

Method: 构建集成ReAct（推理与行动）与RAG（检索增强生成）的自主AI智能体，依据ACMG严重程度指南和ACOG生活质量标准，检索PubMed文献，生成可解释的推理链并独立验证论断，对10,211个HPO术语进行分类，并在基因层面聚合严重程度。

Result: 表型层面在专家 curated 队列上达到93.55%准确率（MCC 0.9237），82.6%–91.4%的论断有直接证据或有效推理支持；基因层面聚合8,738对，识别出3,283个呈严重或极重表型的常染色体隐性配对；外部验证与Mackenzie's Mission基因列表一致率达95.2%。

Conclusion: 该系统通过提供可靠、自动化且有直接证据支持的分类，实现了标准化panel设计，为基因组筛查中的严重程度分类瓶颈提供了可行解决方案。

Abstract: Disease severity classification for genetic conditions is subjective and labor-intensive, creating bottlenecks in genomic screening, where commercial panels vary widely in size and overlap. We developed an autonomous AI agent integrating Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to classify 10,211 Human Phenotype Ontology terms. It uses American College of Medical Genetics (ACMG)-endorsed severity guidelines and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) quality-of-life criteria to retrieve PubMed literature, generate interpretable reasoning chains, and independently verify claims. At the phenotype level, using expert-curated cohorts, the agent achieved 93.55% accuracy (MCC 0.9237) with 82.6% to 91.4% of claims supported by direct evidence or valid inferences. Gene-level severity was aggregated across 8,738 pairs, identifying 3,283 autosomal recessive pairs with severe or profound presentations. External validation showed 95.2% concordance with Mackenzie's Mission gene list. This system enables standardized panel design by providing reliable, automated classification supported by direct evidence.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

### [439] [Detecting Soft Errors in Parallel Software with LLM-tuned Instruction Duplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19531)
*Yafan Huang,Guanpeng Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出PaRID（并行指令复制），一种面向多线程并行程序的软件导向软错误检测框架。它仅需编译期开销，通过并行感知代码变换与LLM调优的性能建模（基于离线表征研究的八项发现），解决了混合串/并行区域支持与低开销检测两大挑战。在NPB基准上，保护开销从平均162.79%降至59.84%，最高获得5倍加速，并保持完整错误检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软错误（soft error）对并行程序的可靠性构成威胁，而现有的软件导向指令复制方法在应用于多线程并行程序时面临两大难题：一是难以支持串行与并行混合的区域结构，二是避免依赖昂贵的动态剖析（dynamic profiling）以降低性能开销。因此需要一种仅需编译期处理、低开销且高效的并行程序软错误检测方案。

Method: PaRID采用软件导向的并行指令复制（PaRallel Instruction Duplication）框架。其核心方法包括：(1) 并行感知的代码变换（parallel-aware code transformation），以支持含串行与并行混合区域的程序；(2) 基于大语言模型调优的性能建模（LLM-tuned performance modeling），以避免昂贵的动态剖析；(3) 方法设计由离线表征研究（offline characterization study）得出的八项可泛化发现（generalizable findings）作为指导。整个框架仅需编译期开销。

Result: 在NPB（NAS Parallel Benchmarks）基准测试上的评估表明：PaRID将保护开销（protection overhead）从平均162.79%降低至平均59.84%，并实现最高5倍的加速，同时保持完整的错误检测有效性（full error detection effectiveness）。

Conclusion: PaRID通过结合并行感知代码变换与LLM调优的性能建模，成功实现了仅依赖编译期开销的多线程并行程序软错误检测，显著降低了保护开销并提升了性能，同时维持了完整的错误检测能力，验证了其在并行应用中快速软错误检测的有效性。

Abstract: We propose PaRID (PaRallel Instruction Duplication), a software-directed soft error detection framework that requires only compile-time effort for multithreading parallel programs. PaRID addresses two key challenges: supporting parallel programs with mixed serial and parallel regions and minimizing performance overhead without relying on costly dynamic profiling. It combines parallel-aware code transformation with LLM-tuned performance modeling, guided by eight generalizable findings from an offline characterization study, to enable fast soft error detection in parallel applications. Evaluation on NPB benchmarks shows that PaRID reduces protection overhead from 162.79% to 59.84% on average and achieves up to 5x speedup while maintaining full error detection effectiveness.

</details>


### [440] [Syndrome Decoding for Silent Data Corruption in Quantized Integer GPU Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19743)
*Pranav Napolean,Vikas Srivastava,Napolean Periathambi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SProbe是一种尾部验证内核，通过Freivalds门控与Reed-Solomon译码，检测并定位量化神经网络GEMM中INT32累加器的静默数据损坏，并在H100上验证其检测能力与开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化神经网络推理在GPU张量核心上进行整数矩阵乘法，其INT32累加器既无奇偶校验也无ECC。瞬态故障会产生合法但错误的整数且不触发中断，形成静默数据损坏（SDC）。基于校验和的ABFT虽能检测此类错误，但判决是二元的：无法定位出错元素或其幅度，且无权重行列校验和在校验轴上存在抵消盲区。

Method: SProbe作为尾部验证内核，读取未修改的厂商GEMM输出。采用61位素域上三个独立求值点的随机Freivalds门，漏检概率至多2^-141。门触发后，对三个素数下的逐行幂和校验子使用Berlekamp-Massey、Chien搜索与Forney组成的Reed-Solomon译码链，恢复每行最多四个碰撞错误的列位置与精确幅度，随后原地修复累加器或重算GEMM。

Result: 在NVIDIA H100上，SProbe在七类故障与四种矩阵规模下检测出所有注入故障，包括TR-ABFT从不检测的构造模式和加权网格码可检测但无法纠正的模式。门控在N=16384时开销为cuBLASLt GEMM时间的49%，N=65536时为11%。在INT8医疗LLM中，保护消除了所有观察到的静默损坏，吞吐开销30%。测量还显示重算在所有测试配置中都快于原地恢复，诊断而非修复主导恢复开销，并报告了验证验证器自身时发现的缺陷。

Conclusion: SProbe将量化GEMM的SDC防护从二元检测推进到可定位、可精确量化的诊断与恢复，在H100上以可控开销实现全面故障检测，并揭示重算优于原地修复及诊断主导开销等工程结论。

Abstract: Quantized neural network inference runs integer matrix multiplications on GPU tensor cores, and the INT32 accumulators inside those cores have neither parity nor ECC. A transient fault in this datapath returns a valid but wrong integer and raises no interrupt. Checksum based Algorithm Based Fault Tolerance (ABFT) can detect such silent data corruptions (SDCs), but its verdict is binary. It cannot identify the corrupted element or its magnitude, and unweighted row and column checksums are blind by construction to errors that cancel on both axes. We present SProbe, a trailing verification kernel that reads the output of an unmodified vendor GEMM. A randomized Freivalds gate with three independent evaluation points in a 61 bit prime field misses a nonzero error with probability at most $2^{-141}$. When the gate fires, per row power sum syndromes over three primes are decoded with the Reed Solomon chain of Berlekamp Massey, Chien search, and Forney, recovering the column and exact magnitude of up to four colliding errors per row. SProbe then repairs the accumulator in place or recomputes the GEMM. On an NVIDIA H100, SProbe detects every injected fault across seven fault classes and four matrix sizes, including constructed patterns that TR-ABFT never detects and patterns that a weighted grid code detects but cannot correct. The gate costs 49% of the cuBLASLt GEMM time at N=16384 and 11% at N=65536. In an INT8 medical LLM, protection eliminates all observed silent corruptions at a 30% throughput cost. Our measurements also show that recomputation is faster than in place recovery in every configuration we tested, that diagnosis rather than repair dominates recovery cost, and we report the defects we found while validating the verifier itself.

</details>


### [441] [Sketching the Error, Not the Product: Post Hoc Fault Recovery for Half Precision GPU Matrix Multiplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19758)
*Pranav Napolean,Vikas Srivastava,Napolean Periathambi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FP-Sketch 是一种面向张量核心 GEMM 的运行时校验器，通过求和 sketch 检测损坏、哈希一阶矩 sketch 定位多个错误条目，可用于大规模训练的静默数据损坏诊断与缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缺陷加速器引起的静默数据损坏（SDC）会中断大规模训练，但现有缓解措施通常以整节点为粒度，缺乏细粒度定位；单 GEMM 的 ABFT 需融合进内核或编码操作数，且每个校验和至多定位一个错误。

Method: FP-Sketch 在未修改的张量核心 GEMM（半精度操作数、FP32 累加与输出）之后运行：用求和 sketch 检测每次调用的损坏；用哈希一阶矩 sketch 并结合独立重计算确认，从而在构造上无假阳性地定位多个损坏条目，并为每个故障给出坐标与幅值用于集群诊断。研究浮点下 sketch 噪声（而非桶碰撞）对定位的限制，测量噪声常数随 BLAS 与操作数格式变化，并让桶数按测量噪声而非 n 的拟合幂次来确定（方形乘积下需按 n^2.57 增长）。

Result: 按测量噪声而非 n 的拟合幂次确定桶数，使八个 transformer 形状上的恢复率从 0.402 提升到 1.000；运行时测量噪声可自适应内核与模型。NVBit 指令级注入显示，活跃累加器中的翻转通常仅为典型条目的 2%–9%，这是输出侧注入无法产生的分布。输出侧注入可恢复全部故障；而 NVBit 下按典型幅值定尺寸的引擎恢复率仅 0.550，按测量幅值定尺寸则恢复到 1.000。在 Llama-2-7B 上，守护 MLP down projection 可消除 2048 次位翻转造成的困惑度损伤的 99.4%（BF16）与 99.9%（FP16），干净路径探测开销为 0.78–3.06 ms，对应 GEMM 为 0.35–12.47 ms。

Conclusion: FP-Sketch 通过基于实测噪声定尺寸的 sketch 方案，在不修改 GEMM 的前提下实现了对静默数据损坏的多错误定位与诊断，并在真实模型与指令级注入下显著提升恢复率、降低困惑度损伤，且开销可控。

Abstract: Silent data corruption (SDC) from defective accelerators now interrupts large scale training, yet deployed mitigations act on whole nodes. Algorithm based fault tolerance (ABFT) for a single GEMM has to be fused into the kernel or encode the operands, and it localizes at most one error per checksum. We present FP-Sketch, a verifier that runs after an unmodified tensor core GEMM whose half precision operands are accumulated and delivered at FP32. A sum sketch detects corruption on every call. Hashed first moment sketches, confirmed by independent recomputation, then localize several corrupted entries with no false positives by construction, and each fault yields a coordinate and a magnitude for fleet diagnosis. In floating point, sketch noise rather than bucket collisions limits localization. We measure that noise and find that its constant depends on the BLAS and the operand format and that the bucket count must grow as $n^{2.57}$ for a square product. Sizing the bucket count by measured noise rather than by a fitted power of $n$ raises recovery on eight transformer shapes from 0.402 to 1.000, and measuring the noise at run time adapts the bucket count to the kernel and the model. Instruction level injection with NVBit shows that upsets in a live accumulator are often only 2 to 9% of a typical entry, a population that output side injection cannot produce. Output side injection recovers every fault, while under NVBit the same engine sized for faults of typical magnitude recovers 0.550, and sizing for the measured magnitudes restores 1.000. On Llama-2-7B, guarding the MLP down projections removes 99.4% (BF16) and 99.9% (FP16) of the perplexity damage caused by 2048 bit flips, and the clean path probe costs 0.78 to 3.06 ms against GEMMs of 0.35 to 12.47 ms.

</details>


### [442] [Safe Exploration of Arbitrary Dynamic Dangerous Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19845)
*Caterina Feletti,Paola Flocchini,Giuseppe Prencipe,Nicola Santoro*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文研究了含黑洞的危险动态网络中的安全探索问题：证明在时间连通性假设与必要最少代理数下，无记忆代理可在半同步调度下永续安全探索；并提出带唯一ID和持久记忆、已知安全节点数的可终止算法；同时证明无法仅正确标记通向黑洞的端口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典静态网络探索中代理不知拓扑，动态网络探索虽有部分先验知识研究，但任意动态网络探索由Gotoh等(2021)首次在时间连通性假设下研究。本文在此基础上引入黑洞（代理进入即永久被困）这一危险因素，探讨动态网络中安全探索的可行性边界。

Method: 在时间连通性假设下，首先针对无记忆（oblivious）代理、无网络与团队先验知识、无代理或节点ID、半同步调度器的设定，证明给定必要的最少代理数即可永续探索所有安全节点；随后设计一个让代理安全探索并终止的算法，该算法要求代理具备唯一ID、持久记忆并已知安全节点数；最后给出不可能性证明。

Result: 证明在必要（且充分）代理数下，无记忆代理可在半同步调度器下永续探索安全节点，且无需任何先验知识、ID；给出带唯一ID与持久记忆、已知安全节点数条件下可安全探索并终止的算法；证明在任何情况下，动态网络上的代理团队都无法只正确标记通向黑洞的端口。

Conclusion: 该工作将动态网络探索扩展到危险场景，明确了安全探索的充分条件（代理数）与算法可行性，同时揭示了端口标记这一更细粒度任务的本质不可能性，为动态网络容错探索划定了理论边界。

Abstract: Given a team of agents on the nodes of a graph-based network, the exploration problem requires each node to be visited by at least one agent. In the classical distributed setting of static networks, agents do not know the topology of the network; in the more recently investigated setting of dynamic networks, they may have prior knowledge about the graph class (e.g., trees, tori, rings) or other parameters (e.g., number of nodes). Gotoh et al. (2021) are the first to study the exploration problem of arbitrary dynamic networks, under the necessary minimal assumption that any two nodes will be connected by a temporal path infinitely often (temporal connectivity assumption). In this paper, we extend their study of exploration under temporal connectivity by considering dangerous dynamic networks, i.e., containing possibly one or more black holes. Whenever an agent enters a black hole, it will be trapped forever. The safe exploration problem requires a team to explore all the safe nodes, ensuring that at least one agent will never be trapped in a black hole. We first prove that, given the necessary (and sufficient) number of agents, a team of oblivious agents can perpetually explore the safe nodes without any prior knowledge of the network or the team, without agent or node IDs, under semi-synchronous schedulers. Then, we provide an algorithm that enables agents to safely explore the network and terminate. In this case, agents are equipped with unique IDs and persistent memory, and they know the number of safe nodes. Yet, in both cases, we prove that it is impossible for a team of agents on dynamic networks to correctly mark only the ports leading to black holes.

</details>


### [443] [Xronos: Heterogeneity-Aware Tensor Parallelism for Collaborative LLM Fine-Tuning on Edge CPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19909)
*Wonmi Choi,Sunjae Park,Dohyeok Kwon,Zhixiong Niu,Yeonho Yoo,Chuck Yoo,Gyeongsik Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Xronos，一种面向异构CPU边缘设备的协同微调框架，以张量并行(TP)为执行骨干，结合轻量级性能分析与异构感知的张量划分，缓解慢节点瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SOTA协同微调技术主要针对GPU边缘设备并依赖流水线并行(PP)，但许多边缘平台（IoT网关、智能家居中枢、车载计算机）以CPU为主。PP在CPU设备上因同一CPU同时承担计算与通信导致严重CPU争用，计算停顿比例平均比GPU高5.75倍；改用TP可缓解争用，但现有TP假设设备同构，在异构CPU设备上同步点处快节点空闲率高达34%。

Method: Xronos以张量并行(TP)作为执行骨干，将计算与通信分离以缓解CPU争用；并引入轻量级性能剖析(profiling)配合异构感知的张量划分(heterogeneity-aware tensor partitioning)，以降低慢节点(straggler)瓶颈。

Result: 在多种设备、模型和基准任务上，Xronos将微调时间相比SOTA技术减少18%（对比TP）至56%（对比PP），设备空闲时间比例降低约5.9倍，同时保持模型精度。

Conclusion: PP不适用于CPU边缘设备，TP是更优执行骨干但需解决异构性问题。Xronos通过异构感知张量划分有效缓解慢节点瓶颈，在保证精度的前提下显著提升CPU异构边缘协同微调的效率并降低设备空闲率。

Abstract: Collaborative fine-tuning on edge devices adapts large language models to domain-specific data while keeping each device's data local. State-of-the-art (SOTA) collaborative fine-tuning techniques are largely designed for GPU-based edge devices and rely on pipeline parallelism (PP). However, many edge platforms, including IoT gateways, smart-home hubs, and in-vehicle computers, are primarily CPU-based. This paper reports that PP is ineffective on CPU-based edge devices because the same CPU handles both model computation and communication, which causes severe CPU contention. Our analysis shows that this leads to 5.75$\times$ higher computation stall ratios than on GPU devices on average. Tensor parallelism (TP) can alleviate this contention by separating computation and communication, but existing TP techniques assume homogeneous devices. On heterogeneous CPU edge devices, we find that this assumption causes faster workers to remain idle for up to 34% while waiting for slower devices at synchronization points. To address the limitations, we propose Xronos, a collaborative fine-tuning framework for heterogeneous CPU edge devices. Xronos uses TP as its execution backbone and combines lightweight profiling with heterogeneity-aware tensor partitioning to reduce the straggler bottleneck. Across diverse devices, models, and benchmark tasks, Xronos reduces fine-tuning time by 18% (TP) to 56% (PP) and the ratio of device idle time by $\sim$5.9$\times$ over SOTA techniques, while maintaining the accuracy.

</details>


### [444] [The Life of a Token: from Words to Bits on the Wire](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19924)
*Davide Avesani,Pengwenlong Gu,Sotiris Skaperas,Stefano Secci*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本教程以《神曲》文本为例，梳理LLM训练中从词语到HPC网络流量的转化过程，结合架构分析与流量模型刻画通信需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM规模增至数十亿乃至数万亿参数，训练跨数千加速器，底层通信网络成为关键却常不透明的部分，需要揭示语言如何转化为HPC训练系统中的通信流量。

Method: 以《神曲》具体示例，展示模型架构、分词、嵌入与并行策略如何决定网络中交换数据的体量、结构与时序；结合架构分析、解析流量模型与数值示例。

Result: 刻画了LLM训练的通信需求特征，说明分词、嵌入及并行策略对网络流量形态的影响，并给出支撑训练所需网络要求的实用洞见。

Conclusion: 该教程旨在揭开词语在网络中"旅行"的机制，帮助理解从文本到训练模型全过程对通信网络的实际需求，为HPC训练系统的网络设计提供参考。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) transform vast collections of unstructured text into semantic patterns used for language generation and reasoning tasks. Behind their ease of use lies a complex process: words become tokens, tokens become vectors, and vectors ultimately give rise to streams of bits that flow through High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems. As modern LLMs grow to billions or trillions of parameters, this path increasingly unfolds across thousands of interconnected accelerators, making the underlying communication fabric a critical and often opaque component of model training. This tutorial aims to walk the reader through the journey from words to network traffic, shedding light on how language is translated into communication flows within HPC training systems. Using concrete examples from Dante's Divine Comedy, we illustrate how model architecture, tokenization, embeddings, and parallelization strategies shape the volume, structure, and timing of data exchanged across the network. We combine architectural analysis with analytical traffic models and numerical examples to characterize the communication requirements of LLM training. We try to demystify how words travel across the network and provide practical insights into the network requirements needed to support the journey from text to trained model.

</details>


### [445] [VERA: Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Memory Scaling of HPC Workloads in Kubernetes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19936)
*Ade Pramono,Jie Ren,Ivy Peng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出基于强化学习的垂直内存缩放推荐器VERA，将内存缩放建模为马尔可夫决策过程并在真实Prometheus轨迹上训练，在GKE集群上回收31.6%内存余量，优于默认VPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC工作负载在Kubernetes上运行时存在内存过度配置导致资源利用率低的问题；默认垂直Pod自动扩缩器（VPA）无法预测首次运行的HPC作业中阶段驱动的内存峰值。

Method: 将垂直内存缩放形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），基于3353条真实Prometheus轨迹训练强化学习智能体，构建推荐器VERA。

Result: 在Google Kubernetes Engine实际集群上，使用LAMMPS、图分析、内存内分析和MLPerf 3D-UNet评测：RL智能体回收31.6%可用内存余量，最多发生1次OOM；同期VPA回收率为-7.9%，其推荐在30次运行中不足以避免OOM。

Conclusion: 观测驱动的强化学习推荐器在动态内存缩放上可优于基于历史回溯的启发式方法。

Abstract: Memory over-provisioning results in resource underutilization when HPC workloads run on Kubernetes. The default Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) cannot anticipate phase-driven memory spikes for first-run HPC jobs. In this work, we present a reinforcement learning (RL) recommender VERA that formulates vertical memory scaling as a Markov Decision Process and trains an agent on 3353 real Prometheus traces. Evaluated on a live Google Kubernetes Engine cluster using LAMMPS, graph analytics, in-memory analytics, and MLPerf 3D-UNet, the RL agent reclaims 31.6% of the available memory headroom and incurs at most one OOM event while VPA reclaims -7.9% over the same runs, raising memory provisioning, and its recommendation would have been insufficient to avoid OOM in 30 runs. The results demonstrate that an observation-driven RL recommender could outperform retrospective heuristics for dynamic memory scaling.

</details>


### [446] [P-GADMM: Parallel Group-Based ADMM for Asynchronous Optimization in Heterogeneous Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20006)
*Gaiguo Wei,Qingying Zhang,Heqiang Wang,Yu Zhang,Xiaoxiong Zhong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出P-GADMM，一种面向异构边缘网络的计算感知分组与有界异步协调分布式优化方法，在保证收敛性的同时降低训练墙钟时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ADMM的同步实现异构边缘网络中因快慢客户端速度差异导致效率损失；现有分组式ADMM的分组规则多基于数据相似性或网络拓扑，未显式考虑计算异构性。

Method: P-GADMM依据客户端计算能力与本地数据规模构建计算感知边缘分组，降低组内训练速度差异；结合边缘级聚合与云端有界异步协调，使活跃组无需等待慢组即可参与全局更新，并通过延迟阈值控制过时组信息。针对强凸组目标，在组级有界过时性下对理想化形式给出收敛性保证。

Result: 理论上，强凸目标下理想化P-GADMM在有界组级过时性下呈现时间平均收敛行为，收敛至由过时性引起的渐近误差邻域。实验上，相比代表性基线，P-GADMM降低墙钟训练时间并保持相当的最终精度。

Conclusion: P-GADMM通过计算感知分组与有界异步协调，有效缓解异构边缘网络中的同步等待瓶颈，在效率与精度之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: The Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is widely used for distributed optimization, but its synchronous implementation can suffer from efficiency loss in heterogeneous edge networks, where fast clients or groups need to wait for slower ones before global updates can be completed. Existing group-based ADMM methods reduce communication overhead through grouping, but their grouping rules usually focus on data similarity or network topology and do not explicitly account for computation heterogeneity. To address this issue, this paper proposes Parallel Group-Based ADMM (P-GADMM) for distributed optimization in heterogeneous edge networks. P-GADMM forms computation-aware edge groups according to client computational capabilities and local data sizes, which reduces training-speed variation within each group. It further combines edge-level aggregation with bounded asynchronous coordination at the cloud, allowing active groups to participate in global updates without waiting for slower groups while controlling stale group information through a delay threshold. For strongly convex group objectives, we establish convergence guarantees for an idealized form of P-GADMM under bounded group-level staleness, showing a time-averaged convergence behavior up to a staleness-induced asymptotic error neighborhood. Experiments show that P-GADMM reduces wall-clock training time compared with representative baselines while maintaining comparable final accuracy.

</details>


### [447] [Distributed Edge Inference: an Experimental Study on Multiview Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20009)
*Gianluca Mittone,Giulio Malenza,Marco Aldinucci,Robert Birke*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文通过真实的多视角检测模型（MvDet）与FastFL边缘推理框架，在计算连续体上开展实验，验证其相对集中式方案的推理加速效果，最高获得1.92倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云计算集中式客户端-服务器架构随应用规模增长日益限制可扩展性；云/边/雾计算融合为计算连续体，将基础设施完全去中心化以覆盖泛在资源，但如何在此复杂环境中设计受益应用成为挑战性研究问题。

Method: 以真实世界的多视角检测模型（MvDet）为负载，采用FastFL这一C/C++高性能边缘推理框架实现，并在覆盖不同边缘计算能力与网络带宽的多种实验场景下评估计算性能。

Result: 在使用相同设备的情况下，推理时间相比集中式解决方案最高获得1.92倍的加速。

Conclusion: 实验结果初步验证了计算连续体为超大规模应用带来的机遇，去中心化的边缘协同推理可有效提升推理性能。

Abstract: Computing is evolving rapidly to cater to the increasing demand for sophisticated services, and Cloud computing lays a solid foundation for flexible on-demand provisioning. However, as the size of applications grows, the centralised client-server approach used by Cloud computing increasingly limits the applications' scalability. To achieve ultra-scalability, cloud/edge/fog computing converges into the compute continuum, completely decentralising the infrastructure to encompass universal, pervasive resources. The compute continuum makes devising applications benefitting from this complex environment a challenging research problem. We put the opportunities the compute continuum offers to the test through a real-world multi-view detection model (MvDet) implemented with the FastFL C/C++ high-performance edge inference framework. Computational performance is discussed considering many experimental scenarios, encompassing different edge computational capabilities and network bandwidths. We obtain up to 1.92x speedup in inference time over a centralised solution using the same devices.

</details>


### [448] [The Price of Decentralization, Paid Twice: A Latency Floor and a Minimal Subsidy from a Geographic Decentralization Invariant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20322)
*Ruiyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文将"延迟感知的验证者选择导致地理集中"这一现象形式化，证明任何法定人数阈值 β>γ 的协议中提案者提交延迟下限至少为 ρ（平面上精确为 ρ√(β/γ)），并证明在地点选择博弈中集中化以超临界 O(2) 对称破缺分岔出现，维持去中心化需 Θ(c·ρ/√γ) 的反集中补贴——去中心化在延迟与激励上被"双重付费"，且比例恒定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延迟感知的验证者选择机制（按投票权重、领导权或快速法定人数成员资格奖励低延迟验证者）会促使验证者共址部署，从而侵蚀拜占庭容错所依赖的地理故障独立性。作者希望以协议无关的锐利形式刻画这一"延迟—去中心化"张力，并揭示其与激励设计之间的耦合关系。

Method: 引入 (ρ,γ)-去中心化定义：不存在半径 ρ 的区域持有超过 γ 比例的权益。在此定义下证明任意协议中提案者的 β-法定人数提交延迟下界为 ρ，平面情形下最小值为 ρ√(β/γ)。进一步构建带有真实法定人数延迟奖励的地点选择博弈，将集中化刻画为超临界 O(2) 对称破缺分岔，并推导维持去中心化目标所需的反集中补贴量级 Θ(c·ρ/√γ)。数值验证之外，使用 719 个验证者的 Solana 普查数据与 RIPE-Atlas 延迟矩阵进行实证。

Result: 理论结果：β>γ 时延迟下界为 ρ，平面下精确为 ρ√(β/γ)；集中化为超临界 O(2) 对称破缺分岔；反集中补贴为 Θ(c·ρ/√γ)，去中心化在延迟与激励上的代价成固定比例。实证结果：在 RIPE-Atlas 延迟矩阵上的 719 验证者 Solana 普查显示验证者 Nakamoto 系数为 19，但地理 Nakamoto 系数仅为 1–2。

Conclusion: 作者明确界定贡献范围：几何延迟下限本身是初等的，核心贡献在于将几何下限与激励下界耦合起来的"延迟—补贴"关系。该耦合表明去中心化在延迟和激励两个维度上被同时收费，且两者比例恒定，为评估和设计延迟感知共识机制提供了协议无关的分析框架。

Abstract: Latency-aware validator selection---rewarding validators for low network latency through voting weight, leadership, or fast-quorum membership---is known to push validators to co-locate, eroding the geographic fault-independence that Byzantine fault tolerance assumes. We give this tension a sharp, protocol-agnostic form. Calling a stake configuration (rho,gamma)-decentralized if no radius-rho region holds more than a gamma fraction of stake, we prove that for quorum threshold beta>gamma every proposer's beta-quorum commit latency is at least rho---independent of the protocol---and in the plane the minimum is exactly rho*sqrt(beta/gamma). Our main result couples this geometric floor to an incentive one: in a location-choice game with the true quorum-latency reward, centralization arises as a supercritical O(2)-symmetry-breaking bifurcation, and sustaining a decentralization target costs an anti-concentration subsidy of magnitude Theta(c*rho/sqrt(gamma))---decentralization is paid twice, in latency and in incentives, in a constant ratio. We verify every claim numerically and on measured geography: a 719-validator Solana census on a RIPE-Atlas latency matrix has validator Nakamoto coefficient 19 but geographic Nakamoto 1--2. We are explicit about scope: the floor is elementary; the contribution is the latency--subsidy coupling.

</details>


### [449] [Accelerating Sharded Data Parallelism at Scale with Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20359)
*Gianluca Mittone,Marco Aldinucci*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文借鉴联邦学习的通信原则，提出 FL+FSDP 与 FL+HSDP 两种混合算法，将分片数据并行解耦为松散耦合的联邦组，降低跨组通信并约束全局批大小，在 512 张 A100 上预训练 Llama3.1 8B 时实现最高 8.04 倍数据处理加速与 4.48 的困惑度降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型训练需在数千张 GPU 上耗时数月，分片数据并行是主流加速手段，但在多层异构互连上扩展时产生难以承受的通信开销，因此需要一种在保持扩展性的同时降低通信成本的方法。

Method: 受联邦学习高效通信原则启发，提出 FL+FSDP 和 FL+HSDP 两种混合算法，将分片数据并行与 FedAvg 式聚合交错结合；把大规模 DP 部署解耦为更小、松散耦合的联邦组，仅需极小的组间流量，同时使全局批大小受组规模约束。并通过通信开销的形式化分析与实验进行验证。

Result: 在 512 张 A100 GPU 上进行 Llama3.1 8B 预训练，在相同超参数下，FL+FSDP 与 FL+HSDP 相比对照方案实现最高 8.04 倍的数据处理加速和 4.48 的评估困惑度降低，展现出更优的计算效率与模型质量。

Conclusion: 上述优越性源于通信开销的降低以及全局批大小相对联邦组规模的有界增长，形式化分析与实验共同证明了该方法的可扩展性与灵活性。

Abstract: The symbiotic scaling of artificial intelligence models and high-performance computing systems continually creates algorithmic challenges in their convergence. Foundation models (FMs) are a crucial example, requiring months-long training on thousands of cutting-edge GPUs. Sharded data parallelism (DP) is the dominant strategy to accelerate such computations by splitting data and models across multiple GPUs. However, it incurs prohibitive communication overhead when deployed at scale, particularly on multi-tier interconnects with heterogeneous performance. Inspired by the efficient communication principles of federated learning (FL), this work introduces two hybrid algorithms - FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP - interleaving sharded DP with FedAvg-style aggregations. Such approaches decouple large DP deployments into smaller, loosely-coupled federation groups, requiring minimal inter-group traffic while keeping the global batch size bounded by the groups' size. Formal analysis of communication costs and experimental validation prove their scalability and flexibility. A Llama3.1 8B pre-training on 512 A100 GPUs shows that, under identical hyperparameters, FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP achieve up to 8.04 faster data processing and 4.48 lower evaluation perplexity than their counterparts, demonstrating superior computational efficiency and improved model quality. These properties stem from reduced communication overhead and the bounded growth of the global batch size relative to the federation group size.

</details>


### [450] [A Kubernetes-Native Request Router for Quality-Aware Inference Serving in the Computing Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20497)
*Ignjat Karanovic,Pantelis A. Frangoudis,Ivan Čilić,Ivana Podnar Žarko,Schahram Dustdar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: ASRB是一种面向Kubernetes计算连续体的动态、基于评分的请求路由机制，联合考虑基础设施信息、响应时间与应用级质量指标，支持延迟-精度权衡，并通过自适应监控强度控制开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向跨计算连续体的Kubernetes服务部署，尤其是机器学习工作负载，需要在延迟与精度之间灵活权衡，同时应对大规规模部署中的监控开销问题，且现有方案难以在不修改Kubernetes的前提下实现自适应路由。

Method: ASRB将基础设施层信息、响应时间测量与应用级质量指标统一纳入评分，依据服务提供者定义的QoS准则加权组合策略进行路由；持续监控多层运行时指标以驱动决策并快速适应环境变化；对监控强度进行选择性、自适应调节以降低开销；实现上无需修改Kubernetes。

Result: 在测试床实验中，以降低延迟为调优目标时，ASRB的平均响应时间比面向延迟的先进路由机制至少低10 ms；在侧重精度配置下可获得更高精度；同时实现更低失败率、对环境变化更高响应性，监控成本比相关先进方案最多降低约70%，部分配置下仅付出适度延迟代价。

Conclusion: ASRB能够在Kubernetes环境中便捷部署，提供可由运营商灵活控制的延迟-精度权衡，并在响应时间、精度、失败率、响应性与监控开销等方面综合优于相关先进方案。

Abstract: We introduce Adaptive Score-based Routing Balancer (ASRB), a dynamic, score-based request routing mechanism for Kubernetes-based service deployments over the computing continuum. ASRB jointly considers infrastructure-level information, response time measurements, and application-level quality indicators, with a particular focus on serving Machine Learning (ML) workloads. For these workloads, ASRB balances requests over service instances deployed in the continuum, following service provider-defined policies encoded as weighted combinations of QoS criteria to flexibly address latency-accuracy trade-offs. To drive routing decisions and swiftly adapt to changes in the operating environment, ASRB monitors a range of runtime metrics across multiple system layers. To deal with the associated monitoring overhead, particularly important for large-scale deployments, it selectively and adaptively controls monitoring intensity without sacrificing on routing quality. ASRB is implemented without requiring any modifications to Kubernetes, making it straightforward to deploy and operate in existing cluster environments. Our testbed experiments demonstrate the versatility of ASRB: When tuned for latency reduction, it achieves at least 10 ms lower mean response time compared with latency-oriented state-of-the-art routing mechanisms, while it achieves higher accuracy when this is prioritized through specific configurations, thus enabling flexible and operator-controllable trade-offs. At the same time, it attains reduced failure rates, higher responsiveness to changes in the operating environment, and up to ~70% less monitoring cost than relevant state-of-the-art solutions, at the potential expense of only a modest latency penalty in some configurations.

</details>


### [451] [PixelFlow: Token-Level Workload Management for Efficient Distributed DiT Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20723)
*Zhexiang Zhang,Minchen Yu,Yifan Sun,Xu Bai,Xingliang Yuan,Adel N. Toosi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出 PixelFlow，一种基于 token 级负载管理的分布式 DiT 推理服务系统，通过将请求划分为可变大小的分区并在 GPU 间灵活批处理，在满足延迟 SLO 的同时提升 GPU 利用率，SLO 达标率最高提升 43%，有效吞吐达 SOTA 的 2.8 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线 DiT 图像生成需同时满足延迟 SLO 与 GPU 资源效率。现有系统以请求为单位批处理，对批大小控制能力有限：小批次无法饱和 GPU 算力，大批次则可能违反延迟 SLO；而全局协同调度要求独立推进的 GPU 在接纳新请求前同步，进一步引入延迟。

Method: PixelFlow 采用 token 级负载管理，以图像 token 为粒度切分并批处理请求负载，使每个 GPU 在延迟约束下承担部分额外工作，并将这些部分分散到多 GPU 上以接纳更多并发请求。运行时将请求拆分为可变大小分区并高效批处理；通过优化 token 放置限制跨 GPU 数据交换并平衡负载；利用去噪步间的相似性将剩余传输与计算重叠；SLO 感知调度器将延迟需求兼容的请求分组共享算力，各组独立推进，仅在合并资源接纳新请求时同步。

Result: 在 H100 GPU 上使用 Stable Diffusion 3 与 FLUX.1-dev 评测，PixelFlow 将 SLO 达标率最高提升 43%，有效吞吐（goodput）最高达当前最优 DiT 服务系统的 2.8 倍。

Conclusion: 以 token 为粒度进行分区与批处理，能在细粒度上灵活分配 GPU 算力，兼顾延迟 SLO 与 GPU 利用率；配合通信优化与分组调度，可有效缓解请求级批处理的批大小受限问题及全局同步开销，显著提升 DiT 服务性能。

Abstract: Online image generation with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) must meet latency service-level objectives (SLOs) while using GPU resources efficiently. Existing systems improve GPU utilization by batching multiple requests for joint execution. However, request-level batching offers limited control over batch size: batches may be too small to saturate GPU compute, while larger ones may violate latency SLOs. Globally coordinated scheduling introduces further delays by requiring independently progressing GPUs to synchronize before admitting new work.
  We present PixelFlow, a distributed DiT serving system that addresses these limitations through token-level workload management. Its key idea is to use image tokens (the units a DiT processes to generate an image) to divide and batch request workloads at a finer granularity. This allows each GPU to take on a portion of additional work under latency constraints. By distributing these portions across GPUs, PixelFlow accommodates more concurrent requests, improving GPU utilization while reducing queueing delays. To realize this flexibility, PixelFlow provides a runtime that splits requests into variable-sized partitions and batches them efficiently on each GPU. To reduce the resulting communication overhead, it optimizes token placement to limit cross-GPU data exchange while balancing GPU workloads. It further exploits similarity across denoising steps to overlap the remaining transfers with computation. An SLO-aware scheduler groups GPUs to share compute resources among requests with compatible latency requirements. Each group progresses independently, synchronizing with others only when their combined resources are needed to admit a new request. Evaluation with Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX.1-dev on H100 GPUs shows that PixelFlow improves SLO attainment by up to 43% and achieves up to 2.8 times the goodput of state-of-the-art DiT serving systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [452] [Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning: Stability under Constant Stepsizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19170)
*Xingguo Chen,Zhaohui Wu,Jinguo Ye,Chao Li,Shangdong Yang,Guang Yang,Skylar Liang,Wenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文按结构分析：动机、方法、结果、结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分析论文摘要，提取核心要素。

Method: 逐段识别摘要中的问题陈述、技术手段与验证方式。

Result: 给出简洁的结构化摘要。

Conclusion: 完成摘要解析。

Abstract: Emphatic temporal-difference learning (ETD) stabilizes the expected off-policy TD update and changes its projection geometry, but neither property determines constant-stepsize sampled dynamics. We construct an ergodic two-state counterexample in which the ETD mean map contracts while the sampled product has a positive top Lyapunov exponent. Regenerative-cycle analysis separates this sign from the infinite variance of the follow-on trace. We introduce regularized emphatic TD (RETD), a normalized first-order post-shock repair that leaves the trace and importance ratios unchanged, stores the emphatic TD signal in a leaky scalar state, and releases a delayed correction. RETD's raw equilibrium is an affine shift of the ETD equilibrium; single- and two-regularization readouts recover the ETD fixed point exactly. We prove almost-sure convergence for harmonic diminishing stepsizes and a conditional constant-stepsize moment-contraction result from a Markovian random-product bound. RETD has certified negative exponents on the two-state construction and one Baird point, whereas the positive Baird ETD sign remains numerical.
